prs.title: feat(web-shell): add a waiting minigame to the composer
prs.body:
## Summary

Add a dismissible waiting minigame above the main Web Shell composer. While a
prompt is streaming, a `Juust Relax` strip appears; clicking it opens a
horizontal Tetris board inside the composer footer. The game closes when the
turn ends.

Closes #16036.

## Screenshots

Captured from the Chromium Web Shell harness with the mock daemon
(`packages/web-shell/client/e2e/waiting-minigame.spec.ts`).

| Waiting strip | Expanded board |
| --- | --- |
| ![Waiting strip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/samuelhsin/qwen-code/feat/dac-waiting-minigame/docs/design/waiting-minigame/waiting-minigame-strip.png) | ![Expanded board](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/samuelhsin/qwen-code/feat/dac-waiting-minigame/docs/design/waiting-minigame/waiting-minigame-board.png) |

| Paused | Dark theme, Chinese |
| --- | --- |
| ![Paused](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/samuelhsin/qwen-code/feat/dac-waiting-minigame/docs/design/waiting-minigame/waiting-minigame-paused.png) | ![Dark theme, Chinese](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/samuelhsin/qwen-code/feat/dac-waiting-minigame/docs/design/waiting-minigame/waiting-minigame-dark-zh.png) |

## What changed

- `WaitingMinigame` mounts above `StreamingStatus` in the main App composer
  while `streamingState !== 'idle'` or the daemon reports an active prompt.
- Framework-free engine in `utils/waitingMinigame.ts`: 44×7 board, gravity
  toward increasing columns, rotation with bounded kicks, full-column clears,
  +50 per column, and speed-up by cleared columns.
- Controls: `↑`/`↓` move, `→` speed up, `←` rotate, Space pause/resume,
  Escape collapse. Keys targeting inputs, textareas, contenteditable editors,
  or textboxes are ignored so composer typing is unaffected.
- The strip waits 700ms before appearing, closes when streaming ends, and
  pauses when the tab is hidden.
- Best score and sound preference persist under
  `qwen-code-web-shell-waiting-minigame-{best,sound}`.
- EN and ZH copy; the game stays out of split/side-task panes and
  coarse-pointer devices.

## Tests

```sh
cd packages/web-shell
../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run client/utils/waitingMinigame.test.ts client/components/WaitingMinigame.test.tsx client/i18n.test.ts client/components/StreamingStatus.test.tsx
# 58 passed

../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run client/App.test.tsx
# 1360 passed

../../node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
# passed

../../node_modules/.bin/playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --project=chromium --grep "waiting minigame" --headed
# 2 passed
```

ESLint and Prettier pass for the changed files. The Chromium E2E covers the
strip, expanded board, pause/resume, Escape collapse, close-on-stream-end, and
the dark/Chinese rendering used for the screenshots above.

## Scope

- Main composer only; split and side-task panes are unchanged.
- Desktop / fine-pointer only; no touch controls in this change.
- No daemon, transcript, telemetry, or model changes.

Design notes: [English](https://github.com/samuelhsin/qwen-code/blob/feat/dac-waiting-minigame/docs/design/2026-11-01-web-shell-waiting-minigame.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/samuelhsin/qwen-code/blob/feat/dac-waiting-minigame/docs/design/2026-11-01-web-shell-waiting-minigame.zh-CN.md)

prs.title: fix(verify-pr): keep each verify round in its own comment
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Each `/verify` round now publishes into its own comment. Two follow-ups deferred from #15966 come along, because they change the same publish step.

- **A round replaces only its own status comment.**
  - The status comment the verify job posts now carries a run marker, `<!-- qwen-triage:verify-run=<run_id> -->`.
  - The status step reuses a live status only when it carries this run's marker, which happens on a re-run attempt. Otherwise it posts a fresh one.
  - The publisher writes only into this run's own comment: the live status its verify job posted, or, when the publish job is re-run, the body it already published. It posts a fresh comment when there is none: the job stopped before posting one, or the comment was deleted.
  - A body without findings never replaces one with findings; it is posted beside it. A publish job re-run on its own cannot download results, because the artifact name carries the attempt, so it always renders "results unavailable".
  - Every body opens with a header, written once: the verify marker, this run's marker and, on a body with findings, the substantive marker, ended by a blank line. Every lookup, including the previous-round snapshot, reads markers only from the header, so a marker quoted further down is text.
  - Before this change, both steps took the newest marker comment, and that comment could belong to another round.
- **Evidence images come from the published round.** Images were collected across every round directory, oldest first. Since #15966 the report comes from the newest round. Images now come from the round whose report the comment shows. Without a report, they come from the round whose counts are shown. With neither, they come from the newest round directory.
- **A stale rationale is corrected.** The pre-agent sweep comment said a planted directory with a zeroed timestamp would win the round selection. Under `tail -1`, the plant that would win is one dated after the real round. The sweep deletes every match regardless of date, so only the comment changes.

`WEAK_BODY` is removed. It decided only whether a notice could replace another round's comment, and now no body can.

## Why it's needed

Verify jobs run one at a time per PR, but their publishers queue separately on hosted runners. When round B's verify job starts, round A's status comment is often still "running", waiting for A's publisher.

B's status step took that comment over, and from then on both rounds wrote into one comment. Whichever publisher ran second overwrote the other round's report. The 30-day census found 5 rounds lost this way. For example, on #15604 the merge-ready round 40279562229 was overwritten two minutes later by round 40282196825, in comment 6410056759. When B's publisher ran first, the older round A became the PR's latest report, and the next round's follow-up snapshot read A's report.

A smaller variant has the same cause. A pending run that a newer `/verify` replaced never starts its verify job, but its publisher still posts a "cancelled" notice. That notice replaced the newest live status, which belonged to another round, so the PR showed "cancelled" while that round was still running.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the triage workflow meta-tests.

- **Status step**, run verbatim from the workflow with a stubbed `gh`:
  - it reuses its own run's live status even when a later round's status comes after it;
  - it posts fresh when the live status belongs to another round, when a run id only starts with its own (`12` against `1`), and when a comment carries its marker but is not the bot's;
  - the body it writes opens with the verify, state and run markers, in that order, and the run id is not the attempt number;
  - it does not reuse this run's published report, nor a report that quotes both markers below its header;
  - it still snapshots the newest substantive report, not a newer weak notice, including one that quotes the substantive marker below its header.
- **Publisher:**
  - it patches its own status even when a later round's status follows it, including for a cancelled notice;
  - re-run after it published, a report or a build failure replaces its own report, and a notice replaces its own earlier notice;
  - a notice ("results unavailable", "cancelled", registry outage) is posted beside its own report instead of replacing it;
  - it posts fresh when the newest marker comment is another round's live status or an earlier round's report, including a report that quotes this run's marker below its header;
  - every terminal body, the report and each notice, opens with its header, and the step writes that header once; a run whose artifact holds no `report.md` gets no substantive marker.
- **Evidence:** the fixture holds an earlier round with eight images, the newest complete round with one, and a newer directory holding only an image.
  - The comment shows the newest complete round's image.
  - Without a report, it shows the image of the round whose counts are shown.
  - With neither, it shows the newest directory's image.
  - In each case, images from other rounds are not counted as failing the hosting checks.

### Evidence (Before & After)

**Race replay.** The status-comment block and the publish step were extracted from each workflow revision. They ran against a stubbed `gh` that keeps a real comment list, seeded with an older round's report (#900). Each comment lists the calls that wrote to it:

```
main, A publishes first
  #900   report of round 0 (older)
  #1001  report of round B   [status(101) POST, status(202) PATCH, publish(101) PATCH, publish(202) PATCH]
main, B publishes first
  #900   report of round 0 (older)
  #1001  report of round A   [status(101) POST, status(202) PATCH, publish(202) PATCH, publish(101) PATCH]
main, a cancelled pending run publishes while A is live
  #900   report of round 0 (older)
  #1001  report of round A   [status(101) POST, publish(303) PATCH, publish(101) PATCH]

branch, either order
  #900   report of round 0 (older)
  #1001  report of round A   [status(101) POST, publish(101) PATCH]
  #1002  report of round B   [status(202) POST, publish(202) PATCH]
branch, a cancelled pending run publishes while A is live
  #900   report of round 0 (older)
  #1001  report of round A   [status(101) POST, publish(101) PATCH]
  #1002  ⚠️ incomplete — cancelled   [publish(303) POST]
```

On `main` one of the two rounds is always lost, and the cancelled notice briefly replaces A's live status. On this branch each round keeps its own comment.

Re-running a publish job on its own (attempt 2). Its download looks for its own attempt's artifact, which the verify job never uploaded, so it renders "results unavailable". Review round 1 read this re-run as republishing the full report. The fix for that let the notice replace the report, and round 2 caught it:

```
main, the publisher alone re-runs after publishing
  #1001  report of round A      [status(101) POST, publish(101) PATCH]
  #1002  results unavailable    [publish(101) POST]
1fc3c8e (round 1), same
  #1001  results unavailable    [status(101) POST, publish(101) PATCH, publish(101) PATCH]
branch, same
  #1001  report of round A      [status(101) POST, publish(101) PATCH]
  #1002  results unavailable    [publish(101) POST]
```

A re-run after a notice replaces that notice instead of adding a second one. "Re-run all jobs" re-runs the status step as well. It finds no live status of its own and posts one, so the earlier attempt's report stays beside the new attempt's.

**Tests:**

```
✓ scripts/tests/verify-pr-check.test.js (27 tests)
✓ scripts/tests/serve-ab-workflow.test.js (23 tests | 1 skipped)
✓ scripts/tests/issue-triage-ownership-workflow.test.js (4 tests)
✓ scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js (239 tests | 1 skipped)
✓ scripts/tests/verify-capture.test.js (23 tests)
✓ scripts/tests/review-worktree-cleanup-workflow.test.js (23 tests | 11 skipped)
✓ scripts/tests/qwen-triage-workflow.test.js (197 tests | 1 skipped)
Test Files  7 passed (7)
     Tests  522 passed | 14 skipped (536)
```

**Mutants.** Each mutant was applied to the workflow, and the whole triage suite was run against it. All 35 turn it red. E4 also survived on `main`: the hosting test asserted the skip note but not its count. It is now pinned by the count. R1–R8 come from review round 1, G/H from round 2 and S from round 3. R4, R6 and R8 are the mutants round 1 reported surviving against the first push.

```
U1  status step reuses any live status                 1 failed
U2  status step reuses the newest comment if live      2 failed
U3  status body without the run marker                 1 failed
U4  run marker matched as a prefix (status step)       1 failed
U5  status lookup ignores the comment owner            2 failed
U6  snapshot takes the newest marker comment           2 failed
P1  publisher ignores the run marker                   1 failed
P2  publisher ignores the comment owner                2 failed
P3  run marker matched as a prefix (publisher)         2 failed
P4  a notice posts fresh beside its own status         1 failed
E1  images collected from every round                  1 failed
E2  reportless images from the newest directory        1 failed
E3  fallback takes the oldest round directory          1 failed
E4  duplicate-name check removed                       1 failed
R1  publisher requires a live status again             1 failed
R2  body header without the run marker                 2 failed
R3  body header puts the run marker first              2 failed
R4  publisher keys on the attempt number               3 failed
R5  status step keys on the attempt number             3 failed
R6  status body puts the run marker first              1 failed
R7  status body opens with a blank line                1 failed
R8  image skip count taken across every round          1 failed
G1  a notice may replace a report                      1 failed
G2  a notice never patches, even its own status        1 failed
G3  every body counts as carrying findings             1 failed
G4  no body counts as carrying findings                1 failed
H1  publisher reads the run marker anywhere            1 failed
H2  status step reads its markers anywhere             1 failed
H3  status step reuses its own report                  1 failed
H4  build failure's substantive marker below header    2 failed
H5  a branch prints the header again                   1 failed
H6  a notice branch overwrites the header              1 failed
H7  the report branch overwrites the header            2 failed
S1  snapshot reads the marker anywhere in a body       1 failed
S2  a body without report.md marked substantive        2 failed
```

The jq expressions were also run on jq 1.6 and 1.7 against the same fixtures, with identical results.

**Real artifacts.** The 18 real `verify-results` artifacts from #15938 were replayed through both revisions' publish step. Each holds a single round. A no-op uploader was used so the evidence-image section is rendered too (59 images). All 18 comment bodies are byte-identical between `main` and this branch, except for the run-marker line this branch adds as each body's second line. (Only build-failure bodies change shape otherwise: their substantive marker moves up into the header.) They include the #15604 pair named above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

The publish job runs only on `ubuntu-latest`, and the status step runs in the verify job's `node:22-bookworm` container. macOS and Windows are covered by CI only.

### Environment (optional)

Local Linux worktree. Workflow steps were extracted from the YAML and executed with a stubbed `gh` and the real artifact checker, as the meta-tests do.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff:** a status comment whose own publisher never ran now stays "running", linking to a finished run. Before this change, the next round took that comment over. This needs the publish job itself to fail: it runs under `always()` and falls back to posting fresh. Each round now leaves its own comment. That is what already happened whenever publishers did not overlap. One case adds a comment that did not exist before: a pending run replaced by a newer `/verify` now leaves its own "cancelled" notice, where it used to overwrite another round's live status.
- **Transition:** a round started on the old workflow can still take over a new round's live status once, if it publishes after that status is posted. In that case the old round's own status stays "running", the new round finds its status gone and posts its report fresh, and no report is lost. This lasts only while rounds started before the merge are still in flight. Build-failure reports posted before the merge carry their substantive marker below the header, so they are no longer picked as the previous-round snapshot; the snapshot falls back to the newest other report.
- **Not validated / out of scope:**
  - When round B's verify job starts before A publishes, B still cannot read A's report as its previous-report snapshot, because that report does not exist yet. This PR does not change that ordering.
  - The tmux lane keeps a single comment per PR by design. Its report selection still uses `sort | head -1`, which the #15966 verification round pointed out. It is a separate lane and is not touched here.
  - No live `/verify` run was done: `issue_comment` workflows run from the default branch, so this takes effect only after merge.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes:** none. The workflow is now 371667 bytes, 1481 bytes more than on `main` and 1836 over the recorded baseline of 369831. That is within the 4096-byte allowance, so the baseline is not bumped.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #15938 and #15966. It closes the two items deferred in comment 6538220311.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

每一轮 `/verify` 现在发布到它自己的那条评论里。#15966 延后的两项也一起处理了，因为它们改的是同一个发布步骤。

- **每轮只替换自己的状态评论。**
  - verify job 发出的状态评论现在带一个本轮标记：`<!-- qwen-triage:verify-run=<run_id> -->`。
  - 状态步骤只在 running 状态带着本轮标记时才复用它，这种情况出现在重跑同一个 run 时。其他情况一律发新评论。
  - 发布端只写进本轮自己的评论：verify job 发的 running 状态，或者在发布 job 被重跑时，它已经发布过的那条正文。没有这样的评论时就发新评论，比如 job 在发状态之前就已结束，或者评论被删了。
  - 不带结论的正文永远不会替换带结论的正文，而是在旁边另发一条。单独重跑发布 job 时，由于产物名带 attempt 序号，它下载不到结果，发出的一定是"results unavailable"。
  - 每条正文都以头部开头，头部只写一次：verify 标记、本轮标记，带结论的正文还有 substantive 标记，以空行结束。所有查找（包括上一轮快照）都只从头部读标记，正文后面引用的标记只是文本。
  - 改动前，这两个步骤取的都是最新一条带标记的评论，而那条评论可能属于别的轮次。
- **证据图来自所发布的那一轮。** 原来证据图从所有轮次目录收集，按排序取最旧的。#15966 之后，报告取的是最新一轮。现在图片取自评论所展示报告的那一轮。没有报告时，取展示计数的那一轮；两者都没有时，取最新的轮次目录。
- **修正一处过时的理由注释。** 预清扫的注释说"时间戳清零的植入目录"会在轮次选择中胜出。改成 `tail -1` 之后，会胜出的是日期晚于真实轮次的植入。清扫会删除所有匹配项、与日期无关，所以只需改注释。

删除了 `WEAK_BODY`。它唯一的作用是决定一条通知能否替换别的轮次的评论，而现在任何正文都不能这样做了。

## 为什么需要

verify job 按 PR 串行执行，但它们的发布端是在托管 runner 上单独排队的。所以 B 轮的 verify job 开始时，A 轮的状态评论往往还处于 running，在等 A 的发布端。

B 的状态步骤会接管这条评论，此后两轮都写进同一条评论，后运行的发布端会覆盖另一轮的报告。30 天普查发现 5 轮报告就这样丢了。例如 #15604：merge-ready 轮 40279562229 在两分钟后被 40282196825 轮覆盖，覆盖发生在评论 6410056759 上。如果 B 的发布端先跑，较旧的 A 轮反而成了 PR 上最新的报告，下一轮的跟进快照读到的就是 A 的报告。

还有一个同源的小变体。被更新的 `/verify` 顶替的 pending run 不会启动 verify job，但它的发布端仍会发一条"已取消"通知。这条通知替换的是最新的 running 状态，而那条状态属于另一轮，于是那一轮还在跑时，PR 上却显示"已取消"。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

运行 triage 工作流的元测试。

- **状态步骤**，从工作流中原样截取，配合桩化的 `gh` 运行：
  - 即使后面跟着更晚一轮的状态评论，它仍复用本轮自己的 running 状态；
  - 以下情况都发新评论：running 状态属于另一轮；run id 只是以本轮 id 开头（`12` 对 `1`）；评论带有本轮标记但不是 bot 发的；
  - 它写出的正文依次以 verify 标记、状态标记、本轮标记开头，且用的是 run id 而不是 attempt 序号；
  - 它不会复用本轮已发布的报告，也不会复用在头部以下引用了两个标记的报告；
  - 快照仍取最新的实质报告，而不是更新的弱通知，包括在头部以下引用了 substantive 标记的通知。
- **发布端：**
  - 即使后面跟着更晚一轮的状态，它仍 PATCH 本轮自己的状态，取消通知也一样；
  - 发布之后被重跑时，报告或构建失败会替换本轮的报告，通知会替换本轮之前的通知；
  - 通知（"results unavailable"、取消、registry 不可达）会发在本轮报告旁边，而不是替换它；
  - 最新一条带标记的评论是另一轮的 running 状态或更早一轮的报告时，它发新评论，包括在头部以下引用了本轮标记的报告；
  - 所有最终正文（报告和各种通知）都以头部开头，且该步骤只写一次头部；产物里没有 `report.md` 的运行不带 substantive 标记。
- **证据图：** 夹具里有一个带 8 张图的较早轮次、一个带 1 张图的最新完整轮次，以及一个只有图的更新目录。
  - 评论展示最新完整轮次的图；
  - 没有报告时，展示显示计数的那一轮的图；
  - 两者都没有时，展示最新目录的图。
  - 每种情况下，其他轮次的图都不会被计入"未通过托管检查"。

### 证据（前后对比）

竞态重放、测试结果、变异体和真实产物的结果见上方英文部分。

- **竞态重放：** 在 `main` 上，两轮中总有一轮丢失，取消通知还会短暂替换 A 的 running 状态。在本分支上，每一轮都保留自己的评论。
- **重跑：** 单独重跑发布 job（attempt 2）时，它找的是本 attempt 的产物，而 verify job 从未上传过，所以发出的是"results unavailable"。评审第 1 轮把这种重跑理解为重发整份报告，为此做的修改却让通知替换了报告，第 2 轮指出了这一点。现在与 `main` 一样，通知发在报告旁边；在通知之后重跑，则替换那条通知而不再叠加。"Re-run all jobs" 会连状态步骤一起重跑，它找不到本轮的 running 状态，会发一条新的，所以前一次 attempt 的报告会和新 attempt 的报告并存。
- **真实产物：** #15938 用过的 18 份真实产物都只有一个轮次。用空操作上传器让证据图那一段也渲染出来（共 59 张图），除了本分支在每份正文第二行加的本轮标记外，`main` 和本分支的正文 18 份全部逐字节相同，其中包括上面提到的 #15604 那一对。（此外只有构建失败的正文形状有变化：其 substantive 标记移进了头部。）

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

发布 job 只在 `ubuntu-latest` 上运行，状态步骤在 verify job 的 `node:22-bookworm` 容器里运行。macOS 和 Windows 仅由 CI 覆盖。

### 环境（可选）

本地 Linux worktree。工作流步骤从 YAML 中提取出来，用桩化的 `gh` 和真实的产物校验脚本执行，与元测试的做法相同。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险或权衡：** 如果某轮的发布端从未运行，它的状态评论现在会一直停在 running，链接指向一个已结束的 run。改动前，下一轮会接管这条评论。出现这种情况需要发布 job 本身失败，而它在 `always()` 下运行、失败时还会回退为发新评论。现在每一轮都留下自己的评论；发布端不重叠时，原来也是这样。有一种情况会多出一条以前没有的评论：被更新的 `/verify` 顶替的 pending run 现在会留下自己的"已取消"通知，以前它会覆盖另一轮的 running 状态。
- **过渡期：** 按旧工作流启动的轮次，如果在新轮次发出状态之后才发布，仍可能接管一次新轮次的 running 状态。这时旧轮次自己的状态会停在 running，新轮次发现自己的状态没了就发新评论，不会丢报告。这只持续到合入前启动的轮次全部结束。合入前发布的构建失败报告，其 substantive 标记在头部下方，因此不再被选为上一轮快照，快照会退回到最新的其他报告。
- **未验证 / 不在范围内：**
  - B 轮的 verify job 在 A 发布之前启动时，B 仍读不到 A 的报告作为上一轮快照，因为那时 A 的报告还不存在。本 PR 不改变这个时序。
  - tmux 通道按设计每个 PR 只保留一条评论。它的报告选择仍是 `sort | head -1`，这一点 #15966 的验证轮已经指出。它是独立的通道，本 PR 不改动。
  - 没有做真实的 `/verify` 运行：`issue_comment` 触发的工作流从默认分支运行，所以本改动合入后才生效。
- **破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：** 无。工作流现为 371667 字节，比 `main` 多 1481 字节，比记录的基线 369831 多 1836 字节，仍在 4096 字节的额度内，所以没有上调基线。

## 关联 Issue

#15938 和 #15966 的后续，收掉评论 6538220311 中延后的两项。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): default ConEmu/Cmder to the static render path
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Qwen Code now detects ConEmu/Cmder (`ConEmuPID` or `CMDER_SHELL`) and defaults those terminals to the append-only/Static renderer instead of Virtualized History. The detection is applied in `shouldUseVirtualViewport()`, so the interactive startup and `AppContainer` paths make the same decision. The change also fixes the injected-env handling in `a11y-screen-reader.ts`; that module currently has no production importer, so this hunk is pre-wiring rather than a third live caller. An explicit `"ui.useTerminalBuffer": true` still selects Virtualized History, and an explicit `false` still forces the append-only path. The screen-reader and non-interactive paths are unchanged. A troubleshooting note documents both the automatic behavior and the override.

## Why it's needed

Fixes #8385

On ConEmu/Cmder for Windows, streaming output flickers because ConEmu repaints on every write and does not coalesce the rapid full-viewport rewrites that Virtualized History performs. Setting `CI=true` removes the flicker because it switches to the legacy append-only path, which only redraws the dynamic tail. Maintainer triage confirmed this root cause and suggested auto-detecting ConEmu/Cmder (`ConEmuPID`/`CMDER_SHELL`) and defaulting those terminals to the legacy path; `useTerminalProgress.ts` already uses `ConEmuPID` as a detection precedent. This PR implements that scoped fix without changing the synchronized-output allowlist (ConEmu DEC 2026 support is still unconfirmed) and without adding a slower spinner.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. On ConEmu or Cmder for Windows, launch `qwen` and stream a response. Before this PR the whole viewport flickers; after this PR the append-only renderer is selected automatically and the flicker should be gone.
2. Set `"ui.useTerminalBuffer": true`, restart, and confirm Virtualized History is restored (the flicker may return). This proves the detection is only a default, not an override.
3. In a terminal without `ConEmuPID`/`CMDER_SHELL`, confirm the default is still Virtualized History when `ui.useTerminalBuffer` is unset.
4. Run the focused suites from `packages/cli`:
   `npx vitest run src/ui/utils/terminal-buffer.test.ts src/ui/opentui/a11y-screen-reader.test.ts src/ui/startInteractiveUI.test.tsx`

### Evidence (Before & After)

Decision probe against the real `shouldUseVirtualViewport()` (Node 24, source at the branch point vs. this branch):

Before (`origin/main` @ `cc2de634`):

```text
no ConEmu env, unset setting:  true
ConEmuPID set, unset setting:  true   <- full-viewport rewrite path
CMDER_SHELL set, unset setting: true   <- full-viewport rewrite path
explicit true:                 true
explicit false:                false
screen reader / non-interactive: false
```

After:

```text
ConEmuPID set, unset setting:  false
CMDER_SHELL set, unset setting: false
explicit true:                 true
no ConEmu env, unset setting:  true
screen reader / non-interactive: false
```

Unit tests (independently re-run on the committed tree): 3 files / 61 tests passed. The new ambient-env test calls the production 3-argument shape with `ConEmuPID` set in `process.env`; mutating the default to `{}` makes it fail with `expected true to be false`. The broader `AppContainer.test.tsx` suite also passed 214/214. `tsc --noEmit`, ESLint on the changed TS files, Prettier, and `node scripts/build.js --cli-only` all pass.

Honest caveat: this development machine does not run ConEmu/Cmder, so the visual flicker itself was not reproduced here. The before/after evidence above verifies the render-path decision that causes it; final visual confirmation needs a ConEmu/Cmder run.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | N/A |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ tested |
| 🐧 Linux | N/A |

### Environment (optional)

Windows 11, Node v24.21.0, pnpm via corepack. ConEmu/Cmder was not installed locally; verification used real environment keys against the decision function plus the unit suites.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: ConEmu/Cmder users lose Virtualized History (mouse wheel, virtual scrolling) by default. That is the intended anti-flicker tradeoff, and it is reversible with `"ui.useTerminalBuffer": true`. `CMDER_SHELL` can also be present when Cmder is hosted by Windows Terminal, so those users will get the static path unless they opt back in.
- Not validated / out of scope: no real ConEmu/Cmder visual run; ConEmu was deliberately not added to the DEC 2026 synchronized-output allowlist because support is unconfirmed; no spinner-throttling change; no core changes.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for users. The setting remains tri-state at this call site (`undefined` = terminal default), so explicitly configured `true`/`false` values behave exactly as before. The settings UI may still display the schema default (`true`) while ConEmu/Cmder runs the static path; the troubleshooting note explains the override.

prs.title: fix(cli): give static markdown paragraphs an explicit wrap width
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The Static transcript path now gives Markdown paragraphs an explicit width instead of letting yoga infer the wrapping width for the inner `<Text wrap="wrap">`. The change is opt-in through a new `constrainParagraphWidth` flag on the Markdown renderer, and only the conversation paths enable it: assistant replies, continuations, thoughts, and the user/user-shell prompt echo. Prompt text now also receives an explicit box width after subtracting the prefix, and the history row passes its content width down to those message components.

## Why it's needed

Fixes #14075

On the Static path (`ui.useTerminalBuffer: false`) a wrapped line that reaches the right edge can consume the last column of the margin, so Ink's wrap boundary lands one cell late and the terminal hard-wraps the trailing character onto its own line, followed by a one-column indent shift. The row computes `contentWidth = terminalWidth - 4` for a two-column margin on each side, and the paragraph `<Box>`/`<Text>` had no width of its own, so the implicit yoga measurement was the only thing deciding where the text stopped. At 100 columns the result can be a 99-cell line inside a 98-cell budget; at 110/120 columns the line can land exactly on the terminal edge with zero right slack. Giving the paragraph an explicit width removes that implicit-measurement path. Virtualized History renders through its own viewport measurement and is unaffected.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Set `"ui.useTerminalBuffer": false` and use a 100-column terminal; send or receive a paragraph long enough that a line fills the available width. Before this PR, the line can reach the terminal edge and the continuation indent can shift; after this PR, every line stays inside the two-column right margin.
2. Repeat at 110 and 120 columns. Before, a full line can equal the terminal width (zero slack); after, the maximum line width is `terminalWidth - 2`.
3. Confirm Virtualized History (`ui.useTerminalBuffer: true`) still renders normally; the components are shared, so the existing VP tests are the guard.
4. From `packages/cli`, run: `npx vitest run src/ui/components/HistoryItemDisplay.test.tsx src/ui/utils/MarkdownDisplay.test.tsx src/ui/components/messages/ConversationMessages.test.tsx src/ui/components/ConsentPrompt.test.tsx src/ui/components/views/ToolsList.test.tsx`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Render-level probe of the real Static tree (`<Static>` → `HistoryItemDisplay` → `ConversationMessages` / `MarkdownDisplay`) at forced widths; every line measured with `string-width` after `strip-ansi`. The expected maximum is `terminalWidth - 2` (left margin + content; two columns remain on the right).

| case | width | before | after |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Static assistant | 100 | 99 cells > 98 budget | 97, clean |
| Static user prompt | 100 | 99 > 98 | 97, clean |
| Static assistant | 110 | **110 = terminal width**, continuation indent 5 | 106, indent 4 |
| Static assistant | 120 | **120 = terminal width**, indent 5 | 117, indent 4 |
| Static user prompt | 110/120 | 110/120, indent 5 | 106/117, indent 4 |

The new regression test renders the Static path at width 100 for both an assistant reply and a user prompt and asserts that no rendered line exceeds `terminalWidth - 2`. It fails on the base commit and passes with the fix.

**Independent verification (Aleks-0, 2026-10-31).** On today's `main`, reverting only the three production files to base while leaving the test unchanged makes the regression test fail (`2 failed | 42 passed`) with the expected overflow lines; applying the fix makes the same 44 tests pass. On Windows, `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint:ci`, `npm run bundle`, and the touched-file tests are green. This independently confirms the regression test is load-bearing. The residual caveat stands: the fix buys two columns of right slack while ambiguous-width deltas can reach +3, and no real 100-column Windows ConPTY visual run has happened; #14075 should stay open for reporter confirmation.

Focused verification: 5 test files / 266 tests passed. `tsc --noEmit`, ESLint on the changed TypeScript files, Prettier, and the CLI build all pass.

Honest caveat: the render harness did not reproduce the literal column-0 orphan; what it reproduces deterministically is the zero-right-slack geometry and the continuation indent shift. The issue analysis suggests the column-0 symptom additionally needs a terminal that draws East-Asian-ambiguous glyphs double-width, which the render harness cannot model. No real 100-column ConPTY visual run was performed.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | N/A |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ tested |
| 🐧 Linux | N/A |

### Environment (optional)

Windows 11, Node v24.21.0, pnpm via corepack. Verification is render-level plus unit tests; the interactive visual check requires a 100-column ConPTY.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the explicit width is opt-in for conversation paths only. Other `MarkdownDisplay` callers still rely on implicit measurement, because some pass a `contentWidth` that includes their own border or padding chrome and would clip if forced to that width (for example the consent prompt was checked). Those callers can opt in after a per-caller width audit.
- Virtualized History shares the same components. The change can only make lines narrower, never wider; all existing VP-related tests pass. No Ink patch, dependency, or setting is added.
- Not validated / out of scope: no real terminal visual run of the column-0 orphan; the terminal-side ambiguous-width behavior is not modeled. A residual five-space continuation indent at width 90 comes from Ink's `trim: false` wrapping and is independent of this change.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14075

Thanks to @holny for the earlier reproduction attempts recorded in the issue, and to @Aleks-0 for the independent local verification; this PR follows the maintainer's explicit-width direction rather than changing Ink.

AI assistance: the change, tests, and evidence were drafted with an AI coding agent and audited/re-run by the contributor.

2. 在 110、120 列重复。修复前整行可能等于终端宽度（零余量）；修复后最大行宽为 `terminalWidth - 2`。
3. 确认 Virtualized History（`ui.useTerminalBuffer: true`）仍正常渲染；组件是共享的，现有 VP 测试就是守卫。
4. 在 `packages/cli` 下运行：`npx vitest run src/ui/components/HistoryItemDisplay.test.tsx src/ui/utils/MarkdownDisplay.test.tsx src/ui/components/messages/ConversationMessages.test.tsx src/ui/components/ConsentPrompt.test.tsx src/ui/components/views/ToolsList.test.tsx`。

## 修改前后证据

对真实 Static 渲染树（`<Static>` → `HistoryItemDisplay` → `ConversationMessages` / `MarkdownDisplay`）在固定宽度下做渲染级探针；每行用 `strip-ansi` 后以 `string-width` 测量。预期最大宽度为 `terminalWidth - 2`（左边距 + 内容；右侧保留 2 列）。

| 场景 | 宽度 | 修复前 | 修复后 |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Static 助手回复 | 100 | 99 列 > 98 预算 | 97，正常 |
| Static 用户提示 | 100 | 99 > 98 | 97，正常 |
| Static 助手回复 | 110 | **110 = 终端宽度**，续行缩进 5 | 106，缩进 4 |
| Static 助手回复 | 120 | **120 = 终端宽度**，缩进 5 | 117，缩进 4 |
| Static 用户提示 | 110/120 | 110/120，缩进 5 | 106/117，缩进 4 |

新增回归测试在宽度 100 下分别渲染 Static 的助手回复和用户提示，断言没有任何一行超过 `terminalWidth - 2`。该测试在 base commit 上失败，修复后通过。

**独立复验（Aleks-0，2026-10-31）**：在今天的 `main` 上，只把三个生产文件回退到 base、测试保持不变，回归测试失败（`2 failed | 42 passed`），失败行正是预期的溢出内容；应用修复后同样的 44 个测试全部通过。Windows 上 `npm run build`、`npm run typecheck`、`npm run lint:ci`、`npm run bundle` 以及被改动文件的测试均为绿色。这独立证明了回归测试是承重的。遗留说明不变：本修复只买到 2 列右侧余量，而 ambiguous-width 的宽度偏差可达 +3；仍未做真实 100 列 Windows ConPTY 的视觉验证，#14075 应保持打开，等待报告者确认。

聚焦验证：5 个测试文件 / 266 条测试通过。`tsc --noEmit`、改动 TS 文件的 ESLint、Prettier、CLI build 均通过。

诚实说明：渲染探针没有复现字面意义上的「列 0 孤字」；它确定性复现的是右侧零余量几何和续行缩进偏移。issue 分析认为列 0 症状还需要终端把 East-Asian ambiguous 字符按双宽绘制，这是渲染探针无法建模的。没有做真实 100 列 ConPTY 的视觉验证。

## 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | N/A |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ 已测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | N/A |

## 环境

Windows 11，Node v24.21.0，pnpm 通过 corepack。验证方式是渲染级探针 + 单测；交互式视觉确认需要 100 列 ConPTY。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：显式宽度只对会话路径按需开启。其他 `MarkdownDisplay` 调用方仍依赖隐式测量，因为它们传入的 `contentWidth` 可能包含自己的边框/内边距，强制套用会裁切（例如 consent prompt 已验证）。这些调用方可以在逐个审计宽度后再 opt-in。

prs.body:
## What this PR does

This checks the two-call crash-barrier plan against the initial approval snapshot by ordinal, using each call's runtimeCallId, partIndex, prepareKey, and requestDigest. It also rejects a non-null per-member Action ID when it does not match the durable Action for that ordinal, while allowing the field to remain null before the crash. The existing fast-tier contract test pins these checks. There is no production behavior change.

## Why it's needed

The [post-merge report for #15945](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15945#issuecomment-6538096517) records stale-build runs where the barrier accepted a reversed two-call plan and placed the decided Action on the sibling entry; recovery later rejected the mismatch with 503. The clean-head run had consistent member bindings. This change makes the barrier catch that regression before the crash and keeps the check covered at unit speed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Review the `sibling-approval` crash barrier and confirm it compares each pre-crash call member with the corresponding member from the initial approval snapshot before the process is killed. A reversed identity mapping or a non-null Action ID on the wrong member should fail at the barrier. The fast-tier contract suite should fail if the comparison loop, one of its identity fields, or the ordinal-to-Action-ID mapping is removed or reversed. Local focused verification passed: 47 passed, 1 skipped; ESLint and Prettier passed.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — internal test hardening; no user-visible change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Windows, Node.js 24.20.0, pnpm 11.24.0.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: A call identity or order change between the first and sibling approval now fails at the crash barrier; that is the regression this gate is intended to catch.
- Not validated / out of scope: No fresh Linux/MySQL real-stack run or full `npm run preflight` was run. A standalone TypeScript check reports diagnostics elsewhere in the current runner, outside this diff; it reports none on the changed lines.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15975

prs.title: fix(cli): accept explicitly named Local Control addresses outside RFC 1918/3927
prs.body:
## What this PR does

An explicitly passed `--local-control-address` is now treated as operator intent: Local Control accepts any non-internal, non-loopback IPv4 the host actually has — including addresses outside RFC 1918/3927 space (some enterprise intranets number their LANs from public ranges) and addresses on VPN/tunnel interfaces (phone and laptop on the same corporate VPN). Automatic advertisement stays RFC 1918/3927-only and untouched; the escape hatch opens only when the operator names the address, and out-of-private-space picks are logged with a loud warning on enable. The explicit pick is also resolved before the no-candidate failure, so a host with zero automatic candidates can still opt in.

## Why it's needed

On a host whose only non-loopback IPv4 is a public-range corporate-intranet address, Local Control was completely unusable: `qwen serve --local-control` exited with "No private IPv4 address is available", and `--local-control-address` could not help because it only disambiguated among candidates that had already passed the RFC 1918 filter. The same dead end hit hosts whose only usable address sits on a VPN/tunnel interface. Refuse-by-default remains the right posture for automatic advertising — the missing piece was a way for an operator to say "yes, this one, I mean it."

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On a host whose address is outside RFC 1918/3927 (or on a VPN/tunnel interface), run `qwen serve --local-control --local-control-address <that-address>`. Expected: a WARNING that the address is outside private/link-local space, then the pairing QR/URL bound to that address; the LAN listener enforces the pairing token (401 without it, 200 with it). Naming an address the host does not have still fails with `unknown_lan_interface`; naming loopback still fails. Without the flag, behavior is unchanged: automatic selection stays RFC 1918/3927-only, and multiple candidates still surface the explicit-choice error. Unit tests cover the full selection matrix (public-range, tunnel interface, loopback, unknown address, ambiguity, no-candidate ordering).

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (released 0.25.1, host's only address on a public-range corporate intranet):

```
$ qwen serve --local-control
qwen serve: No private IPv4 address is available. Local Control needs the host to be on a local network (Wi-Fi or Ethernet).
(exit code 1)
```

After (this branch, same host):

```
$ qwen serve --local-control --local-control-address <public-range-address> --port 4399
qwen serve: WARNING: Local Control address <public-range-address> is outside RFC 1918 private / RFC 3927 link-local space. It was accepted only because it was named explicitly — advertise it only on a network you trust.

Local Control is on. Scan this QR code from the same network:
en0: http://<public-range-address>:4399/#token=<pairing-token>
```

LAN listener auth boundary on that address: `GET /` → 200 (Web Shell), `GET /capabilities` → 401 without the pairing token, 200 with it.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Dev CLI (`npm run dev`) on the affected host; `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, ESLint, and Prettier all pass on the change.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the explicit opt-in deliberately widens what `--local-control-address` accepts; automatic (no-flag) behavior is unchanged, and out-of-private-space picks always log a warning. Acceptance requires the address to exist on a live interface, so wildcards, multicast, and typos stay refused.
- Not validated / out of scope: adding CGNAT (100.64/10) to the default allowlist, and a Web Shell settings-card affordance for the opt-in — both deliberately deferred.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14136

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

显式传入的 `--local-control-address` 现在被视为操作员意图：只要主机真实持有该地址，Local Control 就接受任意非 internal、非 loopback 的 IPv4——包括 RFC 1918/3927 范围之外的地址（一些企业内网用公网段给内网编号），以及 VPN/隧道接口上的地址（手机与电脑同挂一个企业 VPN 的场景）。自动 advertise 路径保持 RFC 1918/3927-only 不变；逃生舱只在操作员显式点名地址时开启，且超出私有段的选取会在 enable 时打出醒目警告。显式选取还先于"无候选"报错解析，因此一个没有任何自动候选的主机也能通过显式指定完成配对。

## 为什么需要

当主机唯一的非 loopback IPv4 是企业内网的公网段地址时，Local Control 完全不可用：`qwen serve --local-control` 直接以 "No private IPv4 address is available" 退出，而 `--local-control-address` 也帮不上忙——它此前只能在已通过 RFC 1918 过滤的候选里消歧。唯一可用地址在 VPN/隧道接口上的主机同样无路可走。对自动 advertise 保持默认拒绝仍是正确姿态，缺的是一条让操作员明确表达"就要这个"的通道。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

在地址超出 RFC 1918/3927（或位于 VPN/隧道接口）的主机上运行 `qwen serve --local-control --local-control-address <该地址>`。预期：先打印地址超出私有段的 WARNING，然后输出绑定该地址的配对二维码/URL；LAN listener 强制 pairing token（无 token 401，有 token 200）。指定主机没有的地址仍以 `unknown_lan_interface` 失败；指定 loopback 仍然失败。不带该 flag 时行为不变：自动选取保持 RFC 1918/3927-only，多候选仍然报"需要显式选择"。单元测试覆盖完整选取矩阵（公网段、隧道接口、loopback、未知地址、歧义、无候选顺序）。

### 证据（Before & After）

Before（已发布 0.25.1，主机唯一地址在企业内网公网段）：`qwen serve --local-control` 以 exit 1 退出，报 "No private IPv4 address is available"。After（本分支，同主机）：WARNING 之后正常打印二维码与 URL，LAN listener 鉴权边界实测通过（无 token 401 / 有 token 200）。

### 测试平台

macOS ✅；Windows / Linux ⚠️ 未测。

## 风险与范围

- 主要权衡：显式 opt-in 是有意放宽 `--local-control-address` 的接受范围；无 flag 的自动行为完全不变，超出私有段的选取必打警告。接受以"主机真实持有该地址"为前提，通配、组播、笔误依旧拒绝。
- 未覆盖/刻意排除：CGNAT（100.64/10）进默认白名单、Web Shell 设置卡片的 opt-in 入口——均有意延后。
- 破坏性变更：无。

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): make persisted session pagination safe for equal mtimes
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Persisted-session pagination now orders files by modification time **and** session file name, and the next-page cursor carries that full position instead of only the timestamp. A caller walking the cursor now sees every session exactly once even when many files share the same mtime.

## Why it's needed

`listSessions()` sorted by mtime alone and resumed the next page with a strict `mtime < cursor`. An mtime is not a unique key: bulk copies, backup restores and coarse-timestamp filesystems routinely produce whole groups of files with an identical `mtimeMs`. When such a group straddled a page boundary, every remaining file tied at the boundary was filtered out, the next page came back empty, and `hasMore` flipped to `false` — so the sessions were silently skipped and the caller reported the list as complete. With 25 session files at one mtime and `size: 5`, the whole history surfaced 5 sessions out of 25.

This is the same hazard the file already documents twice for its own workarounds (`listAllProjectSessionIds` and `findSessionsByTitle` both bypass `listSessions` and its strict `<` cursor precisely for this reason, and both already sort with a filename tie-break). This PR fixes the root cause instead of working around it a third time.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the new colocated test, which builds 25 session files that all share one `mtimeMs`, pages through them with `size: 5`, and asserts every id appears exactly once:

```
cd packages/core && pnpm vitest run src/services/sessionService.test.ts -t "should return every session once when all files share an mtime"
```

Expected: 25 ids, all distinct. Observed before the fix: `expected [ …(5) ] to have a length of 25 but got 5` — page 1 returned 5 items with `hasMore: true`, page 2 returned nothing, and the walk stopped at 5 of 25.

Then run the whole file to confirm existing pagination behaviour is untouched:

```
cd packages/core && pnpm vitest run src/services/sessionService.test.ts
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

Red, on unmodified `main` (commit `06c1f989`):

```
FAIL  src/services/sessionService.test.ts > SessionService > listSessions > should return every session once when all files share an mtime
AssertionError: expected [ …(5) ] to have a length of 25 but got 5
- Expected
+ Received
- 25
+ 5
 ❯ src/services/sessionService.test.ts:1088:20
```

Green, with this PR applied (whole file, not `-t`):

```
✓ src/services/sessionService.test.ts (268 tests) 1210ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  268 passed (268)
```

N/A for screenshots: this is not user-visible UI, the change is in the session-list read path.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local `pnpm vitest` in a worktree; no sandbox or container.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: `ListSessionsResult.nextCursor` widens from `number` to `number | string`. A numeric cursor is still accepted and keeps its exact previous meaning (strict `mtime < cursor`), so cursors already in flight keep working; only the *emitted* form changes, to `"<mtime>|<name>"`. The daemon's cursor is already an opaque string on the wire, so the one place that parsed it (`parseSessionCursor` in `packages/cli/src/serve/server/session-list.ts`) now passes the composite form through instead of rejecting it as invalid — without that, session pagination over the daemon API would have thrown `InvalidCursorError` on page 2. Page size, `hasMore`, the on-disk JSONL format and `getSessionListItem` are unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: the daemon's own suite (`packages/cli/src/serve/server/session-list.test.ts`) could not run in this environment — the CLI package's vitest precheck requires the whole workspace to be built (all `packages/channels/*` `dist` plus generated files), which is unrelated to this change. The daemon edit is strictly additive by inspection: every previously-valid cursor still parses to the same value, and no test in that file asserts that a `|`-bearing cursor throws. `packages/core` typecheck is also not clean on this machine for pre-existing reasons (`mime/lite`, `ignore` resolution in a reused `node_modules`); eslint on all three touched files is clean.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for on-disk data. Consumers that treated `nextCursor` as a number need to treat it as opaque — the daemon already did.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #11706

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

持久化会话分页现在按「修改时间 + 会话文件名」排序，下一页游标携带完整位置，而不只是一个时间戳。调用方沿着游标翻页时，即使大量文件共享同一个 mtime，也能把每个会话恰好返回一次。

## 为什么需要

`listSessions()` 只按 mtime 排序，下一页用严格的 `mtime < cursor` 过滤。mtime 不是唯一键：批量拷贝、备份恢复和粗粒度时间戳的文件系统都会产生一整组 `mtimeMs` 完全相同的文件。当这样一组文件横跨分页边界时，边界上所有并列的文件都被过滤掉，下一页返回空、`hasMore` 变 `false`，这些会话就被静默跳过，而调用方会认为列表已经取完。25 个同 mtime 的会话文件、`size: 5` 时，整个过程只露出 25 个中的 5 个。

这个隐患该文件自己已经记录过两次（`listAllProjectSessionIds` 与 `findSessionsByTitle` 都因此绕开 `listSessions` 及其严格 `<` 游标，并且都已用文件名做 tie-break）。这个 PR 修的是根因，而不是再加第三处绕行。

## 复核方式

新增的测试在 `packages/core/src/services/sessionService.test.ts` 里：造 25 个 mtime 相同的会话文件，用 `size: 5` 翻页，断言每个 id 恰好出现一次。修复前见红为 `expected [ …(5) ] to have a length of 25 but got 5`；修复后整文件 268 个用例全绿。

## 风险与范围

`nextCursor` 类型从 `number` 放宽为 `number | string`。数字游标仍被接受且语义完全不变（严格 `mtime < cursor`），在途游标不受影响；只有输出的形态变成 `"<mtime>|<name>"`。daemon 的游标本来就是不透明字符串，唯一解析它的 `parseSessionCursor` 现在把复合形态原样透传，否则 daemon 会话分页在第 2 页会抛 `InvalidCursorError`。分页大小、`hasMore`、磁盘上的 JSONL 格式与 `getSessionListItem` 均未改动。本机未能运行 daemon 自身的测试套件（需要整仓构建所有 channels 包），这一点已在上面如实说明。

</details>

prs.title: test(managed-agent): pin lapsed-lease ledger writes and the IT's result-store wiring
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Applies the three review suggestions on #16011, which arrived before it merged but were not addressed in it, and this PR's own first review round.

- **A test for the lapsed-lease half of design decision 5 (R1-1).** Decision 5 now says a scanner whose lease lapsed still records and settles until another claim moves the fence, but no test held that half: `aScannerThatLostItsLeaseCannotMoveTheLedger` lets a second claim move the fence before every refusal it checks. The new `AutomationScannerTest#aLapsedLeaseStillWritesUntilAnotherClaimMovesTheFence` claims with a one-minute lease. One second after it lapses, with nobody else claiming, it checks that all nine owner-and-fence ledger writes still land: the holder records, re-pins, defers and settles an occurrence, settles a second one with its detail, advances the watermark, records a gate outcome, blocks the definition and releases the lease. It then lets another claim move the fence and checks that the earlier holder can no longer move the watermark.
- **Pinning the IT's result-store wiring (R1-2).** #16011 wired a `ManagedToolResultStore` into `WorkspaceCsiSqlWorkerMySqlIT`'s journal so its zero-projection assertion reaches the capture guard. Nothing failed if that wiring was removed, and the zero would then hold for the wrong reason. The IT now keeps the store in a local and asserts the journal holds that same instance, right before the zero is asserted.
- **Decision 6 wording (stage-3 note).** "A scanner that lost its lease" could be read as "whose lease expired", the reading decision 5 was just corrected away from. It now says "a scanner whose lease another claim has taken", in both language versions. The same reading in `AutomationScanner`'s class Javadoc and in `AutomationLedgerStore`'s `claim`, `advanceWatermark`, `recordOccurrence` and `settleOccurrence` Javadocs is reworded the same way, and the sibling test is renamed `aScannerWhoseLeaseWasTakenCannotMoveTheLedger`, since its body exercises a takeover.

## Why it's needed

Decision 5's lapsed-lease sentence describes a deliberate property: a tick that outlives its lease must still be able to settle, or the occurrence stays `firing`, the slot is re-driven, and after 64 attempts it is recorded `unknown`. Before this PR, adding a `lease_until` condition to any of the nine ledger writes left every test green. The IT wiring is what makes its zero-projection assertion mean something, and a fixture refactor could drop it silently.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

```bash
mvn -f packages/sdk-java/qwencode/pom.xml -DskipTests -Dgpg.skip=true install
mvn -f packages/managed-agent-server/pom.xml -pl verification -am test \
  -Dtest=AutomationScannerTest -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false
# The IT needs a built CLI (pnpm run build) and a MySQL 8.4 server:
mvn -f packages/managed-agent-server/pom.xml -Pmysql-integration -pl verification -am verify \
  -Dtest=ManagedSchemaProjectionTest -Dit.test=WorkspaceCsiSqlWorkerMySqlIT -Dfailsafe.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false \
  -Dmysql.url='jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:3306/managed_agent_test?createDatabaseIfNotExist=true&allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&useSSL=false' \
  -Dmysql.user=root -Dmysql.password=<password>
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

`AutomationScannerTest` on this head: 77 of 77 pass. Each mutant below adds a lease-expiry condition (the write's own `now` against `lease_until`) to one ledger write in `AutomationLedgerStore`. The whole class was run against each mutant, and the source was restored with a fresh mtime afterwards:

| Write given a `lease_until` condition | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `recordOccurrence` | 76 pass; the new case fails at its record assertion |
| `repinOccurrence` | 76 pass; the new case fails at its re-pin assertion |
| `deferOccurrence` | 76 pass; the new case fails at its defer assertion |
| `settleOccurrence` (reason only) | 76 pass; the new case fails at its settle assertion |
| `advanceWatermark` | 76 pass; the new case fails at its watermark assertion |
| `settleOccurrence` (with the detail) | 76 pass; the new case fails at its detail-settle assertion |
| `recordGateOutcome` | 76 pass; the new case fails at its gate assertion |
| `block` | 76 pass; the new case fails at its `blockedReason` assertion |
| `release` | 76 pass; the new case fails at its `leaseOwner` assertion |
| all nine | 76 pass; the new case fails at its first assertion |

The other 76 cases stay green under every mutant, so before this PR nothing in the class held this property.

`WorkspaceCsiSqlWorkerMySqlIT` on this head, on Linux aarch64 against MySQL 8.4.6: 8 of 8 methods pass (446 s). The CLI bundle was built at #16011's head; the CLI changes merged since do not touch the CSI worker. With `journal.setToolResults(toolResults);` deleted, `sqlGrantExecutesOriginalWorkerAndContinuesWithRetainedHistory` fails on the new check, `[Extracted: toolResults] Expecting actual: null`. Before this PR the same deletion left the IT green, because its zero-projection assertion holds whether or not the store is wired.

Checkstyle (persistence, control-plane and verification, main and test sources; a planted unused import in the test file is reported) and Prettier are clean.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

H2 cases on JDK 25; the MySQL IT on Linux aarch64 with JDK 21, Node 24 and MySQL 8.4.6.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff:** the IT's wiring check reads `ManagedSessionStore`'s private `toolResults` field by name. A rename fails it loudly rather than letting it pass, and the alternative is a production accessor that exists only for a test. No production logic changes: the edits to main sources are Javadoc only.
- **Not validated / out of scope:** R1-2 asked for a behavioural positive control, a receipt committed by a Session with no CSI original that yields one projection row. Every commit in this IT goes through the private CSI lane, so that control needs a second Session with its own public writer and binding, which the IT does not build. That capture path is already exercised on H2, where `ToolPublicationStoreTest` commits receipts through a store wired the same way and claims the resulting projection rows. The wiring check is what this IT needed: with it, removing the wiring fails the IT.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes:** none.

Design document: [English](docs/design/2026-10-07-managed-automation-runtime.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-10-07-managed-automation-runtime.zh-CN.md). Only decision 6's sentence changes, identically in both.

## Linked Issues

Review follow-up to #16011 (threads R1-1 and R1-2, and the stage-3 note on decision 6), including this PR's own R1-1 and R1-2; part of the deployment usability plan (#12380), item 12.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

落实 #16011 的三条评审建议（它们在合入前就已到达，但没有在该 PR 中处理），以及本 PR 第一轮评审的意见。

- **为设计决策 5 中租约过期的那一半补测试（R1-1）。** 决策 5 现在写明：租约已过期的扫描者在另一次 claim 推进 fence 之前仍能记录和结算。但没有测试守住这一半：`aScannerThatLostItsLeaseCannotMoveTheLedger` 在检查每一次拒绝之前，都先让另一次 claim 推进了 fence。新增的 `AutomationScannerTest#aLapsedLeaseStillWritesUntilAnotherClaimMovesTheFence` 以一分钟租约 claim。在租约过期一秒后、且没有其他扫描者 claim 时，它检查全部九个以 owner 与 fence 为条件的台账写入仍能落地：持有者记录、重新钉住、推迟并结算一个 occurrence，带着详情结算第二个 occurrence，推进水位，记录 gate 结果，block 该定义并释放租约。随后让另一次 claim 推进 fence，检查先前的持有者再也无法推进水位。
- **钉住 IT 的结果存储接线（R1-2）。** #16011 把 `ManagedToolResultStore` 接入 `WorkspaceCsiSqlWorkerMySqlIT` 的 journal，使其“零投影”断言能走到捕获守卫。删掉这段接线不会让任何用例失败，而那时“零”的成立理由就错了。现在 IT 把该 store 保存在局部变量中，并在断言零之前断言 journal 持有的正是同一个实例。
- **决策 6 措辞（stage-3 意见）。** “失去租约的扫描者”可能被读成“租约已过期的扫描者”，而决策 5 刚刚纠正的正是这种读法。现改为“租约已被另一次 claim 接手的扫描者”，中英文两版同步修改。`AutomationScanner` 的类注释，以及 `AutomationLedgerStore` 中 `claim`、`advanceWatermark`、`recordOccurrence`、`settleOccurrence` 的方法注释里有同样的读法，已按同样方式改写；兄弟用例的用例体演练的是接管，因此改名为 `aScannerWhoseLeaseWasTakenCannotMoveTheLedger`。

## 为什么需要

决策 5 关于过期租约的那句话描述的是一个有意的性质：超出租约时长的 tick 必须仍能结算，否则 occurrence 停在 `firing`，slot 被重新驱动，64 次后记为 `unknown`。在本 PR 之前，给这九个台账写入中的任何一个加上 `lease_until` 条件，所有测试都仍然全绿。IT 的接线是让零投影断言有意义的前提，而夹具重构可能会悄悄删掉它。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

```bash
mvn -f packages/sdk-java/qwencode/pom.xml -DskipTests -Dgpg.skip=true install
mvn -f packages/managed-agent-server/pom.xml -pl verification -am test \
  -Dtest=AutomationScannerTest -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false
# 该 IT 需要已构建的 CLI（pnpm run build）和 MySQL 8.4 服务：
mvn -f packages/managed-agent-server/pom.xml -Pmysql-integration -pl verification -am verify \
  -Dtest=ManagedSchemaProjectionTest -Dit.test=WorkspaceCsiSqlWorkerMySqlIT -Dfailsafe.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false \
  -Dmysql.url='jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:3306/managed_agent_test?createDatabaseIfNotExist=true&allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&useSSL=false' \
  -Dmysql.user=root -Dmysql.password=<password>
```

### 证据（修改前后）

`AutomationScannerTest` 在当前 head 上 77 个用例全部通过。下表每个变异都给 `AutomationLedgerStore` 中的某一个台账写入加上租约过期条件（以该写入自己的 `now` 对比 `lease_until`）。每个变异都运行了整个测试类，运行后恢复源码并刷新其 mtime：

| 加上 `lease_until` 条件的写入 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| `recordOccurrence` | 76 个通过；新用例在记录断言处失败 |
| `repinOccurrence` | 76 个通过；新用例在重新钉住断言处失败 |
| `deferOccurrence` | 76 个通过；新用例在推迟断言处失败 |
| `settleOccurrence`（仅原因） | 76 个通过；新用例在结算断言处失败 |
| `advanceWatermark` | 76 个通过；新用例在水位断言处失败 |
| `settleOccurrence`（带详情） | 76 个通过；新用例在带详情结算的断言处失败 |
| `recordGateOutcome` | 76 个通过；新用例在 gate 断言处失败 |
| `block` | 76 个通过；新用例在 `blockedReason` 断言处失败 |
| `release` | 76 个通过；新用例在 `leaseOwner` 断言处失败 |
| 九处全部加上 | 76 个通过；新用例在第一个断言处失败 |

其余 76 个用例在每个变异下都保持通过，因此在本 PR 之前，该类中没有任何用例守住这个性质。

`WorkspaceCsiSqlWorkerMySqlIT` 在当前 head 上（Linux aarch64、MySQL 8.4.6）8 个方法全部通过（446 秒）。CLI bundle 构建于 #16011 的 head；此后合入的 CLI 改动不涉及 CSI worker。删除 `journal.setToolResults(toolResults);` 后，`sqlGrantExecutesOriginalWorkerAndContinuesWithRetainedHistory` 在新增检查处失败：`[Extracted: toolResults] Expecting actual: null`。在本 PR 之前，同样的删除会让该 IT 保持通过，因为无论 store 是否接线，零投影断言都成立。

Checkstyle（persistence、control-plane 与 verification 的主代码与测试代码；在测试文件中植入未使用的 import 会被报告）与 Prettier 均干净。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

H2 用例在 JDK 25 上运行；MySQL IT 在 Linux aarch64 上运行，JDK 21、Node 24、MySQL 8.4.6。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险或权衡：** IT 的接线检查按名称读取 `ManagedSessionStore` 的私有字段 `toolResults`。字段改名会让它明确失败，而不是悄悄通过；另一种做法是仅为测试而存在的生产代码访问器。没有修改生产逻辑：对主代码的改动仅限 Javadoc。
- **未验证 / 不在范围内：** R1-2 要求的是一个行为层面的正向对照：由没有 CSI original 的 Session 提交回执，并产生一行投影。该 IT 中的每次提交都经由私有 CSI 通道，因此这个对照需要第二个 Session，带有自己的公开 writer 与 binding，而该 IT 不构建这些。这条捕获路径已在 H2 上得到覆盖：`ToolPublicationStoreTest` 通过以同样方式接线的 store 提交回执，并认领由此产生的投影行。这个 IT 需要的正是接线检查：有了它，删除接线就会让 IT 失败。
- **破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：** 无。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-10-07-managed-automation-runtime.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-10-07-managed-automation-runtime.zh-CN.md)。只改动了决策 6 的那一句，两版一致。

## 关联 Issue

#16011 评审的后续（线程 R1-1、R1-2，以及 stage-3 关于决策 6 的意见），也包括本 PR 自身的 R1-1 与 R1-2；属于部署易用性计划（#12380）第 12 项。

</details>

prs.body:
## What this PR does

Completes the P1 decomposition inventory in the structure-review design with the `ManagedAgentStore` setter investigation (documentation only, both languages). Finding: of the seven public setters, four are Spring `@Autowired(required = false)` optional-dependency injection (`lifecycle`, `definitions`, `sessionWorktrees`, `journalEventTransport`) and three are required plain `@Autowired` injection (`extensionPackages`, `creationSkills`, `worktreeFiles` — its bean is supplied by `ManagedAgentConfiguration.managedWorktreeFiles()`; the direct calls in `VerificationFixtures` are test setup, not production wiring) — not ad-hoc mutable wiring. Converting them to constructor `ObjectProvider` injection is a large change to the central 7,700-line class with ~30 test wiring sites, and its correctness depends on Spring runtime assembly that the manual-setter unit tests do not fully exercise.

## Why it's needed

The design's P1 plan named "replace the 7 public setters with constructor injection" as if it were a small step. The investigation shows it is not: like the broker reconciliation cluster (recorded in #16012), it is a large, risk-bearing change to a central class that warrants a dedicated design pass and full integration verification before implementation. Recording this keeps the plan honest about which remaining slices are incremental and which need a design budget, so the next contributor does not start a risky central refactor expecting a quick win.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Documentation-only change. Confirm both language versions describe the same setter classification (4 optional / 3 required) and the same recommendation, and that the reciprocal links resolve.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — documentation change. Prettier (both CLI paths) green; heading structure aligned across languages.

N/A — documentation only.

prs.body:
## What this PR does

Two things, both documentation-level (the only code change is a javadoc comment):

1. **Carries forward the R3-1 review fix from #15997.** That fix was verified green but not pushed before #15997 merged, so it lands here rather than as a separate follow-up. The D1 structural-debt prose now matches the table: the observation cooldown and the tool-hold inventory are named as extracted collaborators, not as concerns still "mixed into a single class". Both language versions move together. The service's hold-inventory javadoc now defers the detailed discharge invariant to `RuntimeHoldInventory` instead of duplicating it (the round-3 deferred javadoc-duplication observation).

2. **Records the reconciliation-cluster investigation.** Recovery scanning was already deferred as entangled; this PR documents the root cause shared by reconciliation, recovery scanning and cancellation: they all share the service's three concurrent maps (`sessions`, `liveBindings`, `reconciliations`), the binding-lifecycle helpers, and the CAS execution settle. None is a clean standalone seam — extracting any now would inject a dozen maps/helpers/callbacks into a god-class-under-another-name. The design names the prerequisite: a **shared-state registry** slice that owns the maps and lifecycle helpers, to be designed and reviewed on its own before those paths become extractable and before the M6 stamp-before-slot-drop ordering becomes a pinnable seam-level contract.

## Why it's needed

The D1 section is the maintainer's ledger for sizing the remaining god-class work; the prose contradicting the table is exactly the drift that triggers re-research before each slice (the review's root-cause observation). Closing it keeps the ledger trustworthy. Recording the reconciliation entanglement turns "the next slice is hard" into a concrete, reviewable prerequisite instead of forcing a callback-heavy pseudo-collaborator that would make the structure worse.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

This is a documentation change plus one javadoc comment; there is no behavior change. Confirm the D1 prose and table agree in both languages, and that the javadoc still compiles. The hold-inventory and broker suites were re-run on this branch:

prs.title: fix(core): report a registry that kept changing as a PeerControllerError
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Handles the two suggestions from the post-merge review round on #15992, plus what the review and verify rounds on this PR's first revision found:

- **The registry-changed refusal gets a code.** `RegistryChangedError` now extends `PeerControllerError` with the new code `registry-changed`. Its message names the file, like the other registry refusals: `<path> kept changing while this write was in progress; nothing was saved. Try again.`
- **The redo bound gets a test.** A new case lands a rival write inside every mutation attempt, up to five times. Only three attempts run. The case expects the third to give up with `registry-changed` and exactly the message above, and the file to hold only the rival's records. The rival stops after five writes, so a missing bound fails an assertion (the sixth attempt succeeds) instead of hanging the test.
- **The CLI error branches get tests for this error.** `handleRemove`'s `PeerControllerError` branch had no CLI test: the one case that reaches that catch, `reports a failed write`, passed whichever way the branch went, so forcing it either way left `controllers.test.ts` green. `controllers add` and `controllers remove` each get a case that a `registry-changed` error is printed as it stands, and `reports a failed write` now also checks that an I/O failure names the file.

The CLI comment that explains which errors are printed as they stand is updated to match. The CLI logic itself is unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Both findings are on #15992, which merged before the round was posted:

- **R2-1.** Nothing pinned the upper end of `MAX_MUTATION_ATTEMPTS`. Every rival-write case exercised one redo, so deleting `attempt >= MAX_MUTATION_ATTEMPTS` left the suite green and the redo loop unbounded. A writer that kept losing races would then never return.
- **R2-2.** `RegistryChangedError` was a plain `Error`. `handleAdd` and `handleRemove` in `packages/cli/src/commands/sessions/controllers.ts` print a `PeerControllerError` as it stands and treat anything else as an I/O fault. Three lost races in a row therefore reached the user as `Error: could not write <path>: The controller registry kept changing…`. That points at permissions or the disk for what is contention, and a caller branching on `error.code` saw `undefined`. The TUI's `/peers revoke <id>` prints `Could not revoke that controller: <message>` for any error, so only the message changes there.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

```
cd packages/core
npx vitest run src/ipc/peer-controllers.test.ts
cd ../cli
npx vitest run src/commands/sessions/controllers.test.ts
```

The new core case is `gives up, saving nothing, when the registry keeps changing`. The existing helper that lands one rival write between a mutation's read and its commit now takes a count, so this case can land one in each attempt. The new CLI cases are `reports a registry that kept changing as the error it is`, under both `controllers add` and `controllers remove`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Mutation matrix, one change at a time. All twelve are killed. The first eight are in `peer-controllers.ts` and are killed by the new core case:

| mutation | result |
| --- | --- |
| delete `attempt >= MAX_MUTATION_ATTEMPTS` (unbounded redo) | killed: the add succeeds on the sixth attempt, `expected { …(2) } to be an instance of PeerControllerError` |
| `MAX_MUTATION_ATTEMPTS = 1` | killed: `expected "lock" to be called 3 times, but got 1 times` |
| `MAX_MUTATION_ATTEMPTS = 5` | killed: `expected "lock" to be called 3 times, but got 5 times` |
| `RegistryChangedError extends Error` (with a `code` field) | killed: `to be an instance of PeerControllerError` |
| code `invalid-registry` instead of `registry-changed` | killed: `to match object { code: 'registry-changed', …(1) }` |
| no re-read before the write | killed: the add succeeds |
| message without the file path | killed: `to match object { code: 'registry-changed', …(1) }` |
| message reworded as a disk fault (`Permission denied writing ${filePath}; check the disk.`) | killed: `to match object { code: 'registry-changed', …(1) }` |

The last two rows were added after review on the first revision (38d6642225): the verify round found that nothing pinned the file path in the message, and an audit found that nothing pinned its wording either.

The other four are in `controllers.ts`:

| mutation | result |
| --- | --- |
| `handleRemove` prints every error as an I/O failure (`false` for the `instanceof` check) | killed by `controllers remove > reports a registry that kept changing as the error it is`: `expected 'Error: could not write /home/u/.qwen/…' to be 'Error: /home/u/.qwen/peer-controllers…'` |
| `handleRemove` prints every error as it stands (`true` for the `instanceof` check) | killed by `reports a failed write`: `expected 'Error: EROFS' to contain '/home/u/.qwen/peer-controllers.json'` |
| `handleAdd` prints a `registry-changed` error as an I/O failure (`&& error.code !== 'registry-changed'`) | killed by `controllers add > reports a registry that kept changing as the error it is`: `expected 'Error: could not write /home/u/.qwen/…' to be 'Error: /home/u/.qwen/peer-controllers…'` |
| the same in `handleRemove` | killed by `controllers remove > reports a registry that kept changing as the error it is`: `expected 'Error: could not write /home/u/.qwen/…' to be 'Error: /home/u/.qwen/peer-controllers…'` |

- `peer-controllers.test.ts`: 54/54. The new case and the two existing rival-write cases passed 25/25 repeated runs.
- CLI callers: `controllers.test.ts`, `peers-command.test.ts` and `peer-messaging.test.ts` pass, 179/179.
- `eslint --max-warnings 0` and `prettier --check` are clean on the four files. `tsc --noEmit -p packages/core` reports 0 errors. `tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli`, against a fresh core build, reports one error, in `acp-integration/acpAgent.ts`, which this PR does not touch.

The review also suggested a CLI test that fails when the classification is removed. The existing CLI tests cannot do that: `controllers.test.ts` mocks the whole core module with a fake `PeerControllerError`, so it cannot notice the core class reverting to a plain `Error`. The core case pins that, with `toBeInstanceOf(PeerControllerError)`. What the CLI tests do pin is the branch the error feeds. In `handleAdd`, `reports a rejected label as the error it is` catches the branch forced to the I/O side and `names the file when the write itself fails` catches it forced the other way. In `handleRemove`, the new `registry-changed` case catches the branch forced to the I/O side and `reports a failed write` catches it forced the other way.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Only Linux was run. PR CI does not run the macOS and Windows test lanes. The change has no platform branch. The new core case takes the real lock in a temp directory, like the two existing rival-write cases, which no platform skips.

### Environment (optional)

Node 22, Linux x86_64.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff.** `PeerControllerErrorCode` is exported and gains a member. A caller with an exhaustive `switch` over it would now see a new case. No caller in the repo switches on it.
- **Not validated / out of scope.** The residual window between the re-read and the rename, documented in #15992, is unchanged. A related case is left as it was: when the lock wait itself runs out, proper-lockfile's `ELOCKED` (`Lock file is already being held`) is not a `PeerControllerError`, so the CLI still prints it as `Error: could not write <path>: Lock file is already being held`. That is also contention shown as an I/O failure, but it predates this PR and #15992.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes.** None for users. The only visible difference is the message this one failure prints, in the CLI and in `/peers revoke`.

Follow-up to #15992 (#15991).
