prs.title: fix(managed-agent): stop a drained pool owner's not-found from retiring automations
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Draining a Harness pool member can no longer retire automations for good. Two changes, one in pool selection and one in the scanner:

- **Pool selection.** A Session's placement can be RELEASED while no pool member accepts work. Calls for that Session now get `503 harness_pool_unavailable`, the answer the pool already gives when no owner is available. Before, they were routed to the drained owner, which no longer holds the Session and answers `404 hosted_session_not_found`. Two fallbacks stay as they were:
  - A QUIESCING placement still falls back to its owner, which holds the Session until its release commits.
  - An ACTIVE placement on a quiescing owner keeps the existing fallback.
- **Scanner.** `hosted_session_not_found` now retires a definition only when the Store confirms that the Session is no longer ACTIVE. This is the rule admission already applies. While the Session is still ACTIVE:
  - a fire defers under the existing bounded backoff;
  - a reconcile keeps its refusal;
  - the mirror stays live.

  Both retire sites change, the fire path and the reconcile path.

Tests:

- A pool unit test covers a draining owner with no successor, for RELEASED, QUIESCING and ACTIVE placements. For RELEASED it also checks that the Session is taken over once a member accepts.
- Four scanner unit tests cover the fire and reconcile sites, each with the Session still ACTIVE and with the Session ended. The reconcile test with the Session ended uses a small `beforeReconcile` seam added to the automation fake.
- `HostedHarnessPoolMySqlIT` gains a final step on real processes: drain the last accepting member, then fire on a Session it released.

The pool test's RELEASED row and the two scanner tests where the Session is still ACTIVE are the regression tests: each fails without its fix. The two Session-ended tests guard the other direction. They pass before and after the change, and they fail if a Session that really ended stops retiring its definitions.

## Why it's needed

#15795: on a routine drain, a scheduled fire could reach the drained owner after the release. This happens in a one-member pool, or whenever no other member accepts. The owner answers 404, and the scanner read that as the Session being gone:

- It settled the occurrence `skipped(definition_retired)` and retired the mirror.
- Nothing revives the mirror.
- The definition still holds one of the Harness's live slots.

The bug was reproduced on real processes; the reproduction is in the issue.

The two changes cover different cases. The pool change removes the 404 on this path. The scanner change keeps any not-found that still reaches it from becoming permanent, for example from a call already in flight when a release commits.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Unit tests:
  - Build: `mvn -f packages/sdk-java/qwencode/pom.xml install -DskipTests -Dgpg.skip`.
  - Run: `mvn -f packages/managed-agent-server/pom.xml -pl verification -am test -Dtest='AutomationScannerTest,HarnessPoolConnectorTest' -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false`.
- Real processes: run `-Phosted-harness-mysql -Dit.test=HostedHarnessPoolMySqlIT` in `packages/managed-agent-server/verification` against MySQL 8.4, with `-Dqwen.cli.entry` pointing at a bundled `dist/cli.js`.
  - On current `main`, this IT fails before it reaches the new step: `getBean(HarnessPoolConnector.class)` finds no bean, because the pool connector is not a bean after the module split.
  - #15927 fixes that lookup. I ran the IT with an equivalent one-line lookup applied locally; that line is not in this PR.
  - Without the fix, the new step fails only while the drained owner is still a pool member. The pool's periodic refresh drops that member once it holds no unreleased Session, and from then on the old code also answers 503. The pool unit test covers the case deterministically.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- **Unit tests.**
  - `AutomationScannerTest`: 76 run, 0 failed. `HarnessPoolConnectorTest`: 20 run, 0 failed.
  - All 22 test classes matching `*Automation*Test`, `*Harness*Test`, `*Pool*Test` and `*Scanner*Test` in `verification`: 563 run, 0 failed.
  - `verify` with spotbugs, plus `checkstyle:check`, passes on the touched modules.
- **Mutations.** 6 of 6 were killed, each by the tests meant for it:

  | Mutant | Failing tests |
  | :-- | :-- |
  | pool: drop the RELEASED check | pool test [RELEASED] |
  | pool: refuse every non-ACTIVE placement | pool test [QUIESCING] |
  | scanner: retire on every not-found (old behavior) | fire and reconcile, Session still ACTIVE |
  | scanner: never retire on not-found | fire [CLOSED], fire [DELETED], reconcile, Session ended |
  | scanner: old check at the fire site only | fire, Session still ACTIVE |
  | scanner: old check at the reconcile site only | reconcile, Session still ACTIVE |

- **Real processes.**
  - With the fix, the IT passed 4 of 4 runs, about 7 s each.
  - With the pool change reverted, it failed 2 of 2 runs at the new assertion: `DaemonHttpException: POST /session/:id/automations/operations failed with HTTP 404: {"error":"hosted_session_not_found",...}`.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux x86_64, OpenJDK 25.0.2, Maven 3.9.9, Node 22, MySQL 8.4.6 (Docker, `--disable-log-bin`), `dist/cli.js` from `npm run bundle` at `a54bead374`.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff.** When no member accepts, every caller of the acquiring selection path now gets 503 for a RELEASED Session instead of reaching the drained owner. That includes fires, Turns, lifecycle operations and streams. None of these could be served there before either:
  - the owner has dropped the Session;
  - it refuses loads while it does not accept;
  - the Store refuses a stale acquire on a released placement with `harness_placement_released`, which the IT asserts.

  Lifecycle calls that tolerate a 404, such as the Harness close and the lifecycle detach, could "succeed" on the drained owner before, although it did not hold the Session. They now wait as a pool wait until a member accepts and takes the Session over for the operation, the handoff `takeoverForLifecycle` already provides.
- **Not validated / out of scope.**
  - Mirrors that were already retired are not repaired.
  - The public routes' `409 harness_owner_still_live` is tracked in #15666.
  - A call that reads a QUIESCING placement just before the release commits can still reach the owner after it dropped the Session and get 404. The scanner now defers on that. Other callers, such as Turns and the public automation routes, handle it as before.
  - A manual run that meets such a not-found while the Session is ACTIVE now answers the route's code, as other non-definitive 4xx refusals like `hosted_session_blocked` already do. Its claim stays firing and the scanner re-drives it. Before, the run was skipped and the definition retired. How public routes map these codes is #15666's question.
  - If a not-found persists while the Session stays ACTIVE, the definition stays live instead of retiring: each fire's claim defers up to the attempt bound and then settles `unknown`.
  - The connector's attachment cache still keeps an entry across a Harness-initiated release. This change no longer routes a RELEASED Session to its old owner, and a takeover moves the placement to a new epoch, so this path does not reach that entry.
  - The nightly Hosted job runs the IT; it does not run on PRs.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes.** None. No API or contract change.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15795

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

排空 Harness 池成员后，自动化不会再被永久退役。改动有两处，一处在池选择，一处在扫描器：

- **池选择。** 一个 Session 的 placement 可能已是 RELEASED，同时池里没有成员在接收工作。这时该 Session 的调用改为得到 `503 harness_pool_unavailable`，也就是池在没有可用属主时本来就给出的应答。以前这些调用会被路由到已排空的原属主，而它已不再持有该 Session，应答是 `404 hosted_session_not_found`。有两种回落保持不变：
  - QUIESCING 的 placement 仍回落到原属主，原属主在 release 提交前一直持有该 Session。
  - 原属主处于静默状态下的 ACTIVE placement，沿用原来的回落。
- **扫描器。** 只有当 Store 确认该 Session 已不再是 ACTIVE 时，`hosted_session_not_found` 才会让定义退役。这与准入已经使用的规则相同。Session 仍为 ACTIVE 时：
  - fire 按现有的有界退避推迟；
  - reconcile 保留原有的拒绝；
  - 镜像保持 live。

  两处退役点都改了：fire 路径和 reconcile 路径。

测试：

- 一个池单测，覆盖原属主正在排空且没有后继成员的情况，分 RELEASED、QUIESCING、ACTIVE 三种 placement。RELEASED 还检查有成员开始接收后 Session 会被接管。
- 四个扫描器单测，分别覆盖 fire 和 reconcile 两处，每处各测 Session 仍为 ACTIVE 与 Session 已结束两种情况。其中 reconcile 处 Session 已结束的那个测试，用到自动化 fake 里新加的一个小钩子 `beforeReconcile`。
- `HostedHarnessPoolMySqlIT` 在真实进程上新增最后一步：排空最后一个在接收的成员，再对它已释放的 Session 发 fire。

回归测试是池测试的 RELEASED 一行，以及扫描器里 Session 仍为 ACTIVE 的两个测试：去掉对应的修复，它们都会失败。Session 已结束的两个测试守的是另一个方向：改动前后都通过；如果真正结束了的 Session 不再让定义退役，它们会失败。

## 为什么需要

#15795：常规排空时，定时 fire 可能在 release 之后到达已排空的原属主。这会发生在单成员池里，或者其他成员都不接收的时候。原属主应答 404，扫描器把它当作 Session 已经不存在：

- 把这次 occurrence 记为 `skipped(definition_retired)`，并退役镜像。
- 之后没有任何机制能恢复这个镜像。
- 该定义仍占着 Harness 的一个 live 名额。

这个 bug 已在真实进程上复现，复现过程见 issue。

两处改动覆盖不同的情况。池的改动消除了这条路径上的 404。扫描器的改动保证仍可能到达的 not-found 不会变成永久结果，例如 release 提交时正在途中的调用。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 单测：
  - 构建：`mvn -f packages/sdk-java/qwencode/pom.xml install -DskipTests -Dgpg.skip`。
  - 运行：`mvn -f packages/managed-agent-server/pom.xml -pl verification -am test -Dtest='AutomationScannerTest,HarnessPoolConnectorTest' -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false`。
- 真实进程：在 `packages/managed-agent-server/verification` 下用 `-Phosted-harness-mysql -Dit.test=HostedHarnessPoolMySqlIT` 运行，连 MySQL 8.4，`-Dqwen.cli.entry` 指向 bundle 出的 `dist/cli.js`。
  - 在当前 `main` 上，这个 IT 到不了新增的那一步就会失败：`getBean(HarnessPoolConnector.class)` 找不到 bean，因为模块拆分后池连接器已不是 bean。
  - #15927 修复了这处查找。我本地套了一行等价的查找来跑这个 IT，这一行不在本 PR 里。
  - 没有修复时，新增这一步只在已排空的原属主仍是池成员期间失败。原属主不再持有任何未释放的 Session 后，池的定期刷新会把它移出成员，此后旧代码同样答 503。池单测确定性地覆盖了这种情况。

### 证据（修复前后）

- **单测。**
  - `AutomationScannerTest`：运行 76 个，失败 0。`HarnessPoolConnectorTest`：运行 20 个，失败 0。
  - `verification` 里所有匹配 `*Automation*Test`、`*Harness*Test`、`*Pool*Test`、`*Scanner*Test` 的 22 个测试类：运行 563 个，失败 0。
  - 涉及的模块上，带 spotbugs 的 `verify` 加 `checkstyle:check` 通过。
- **变异。** 6 个变异全部被杀，每个都由对应的测试抓到：

  | 变异 | 失败的测试 |
  | :-- | :-- |
  | 池：去掉 RELEASED 检查 | 池测试 [RELEASED] |
  | 池：拒绝所有非 ACTIVE 的 placement | 池测试 [QUIESCING] |
  | 扫描器：遇到任何 not-found 都退役（旧行为） | fire 与 reconcile，Session 仍为 ACTIVE |
  | 扫描器：遇到 not-found 从不退役 | fire [CLOSED]、fire [DELETED]、reconcile，Session 已结束 |
  | 扫描器：只在 fire 处用旧判断 | fire，Session 仍为 ACTIVE |
  | 扫描器：只在 reconcile 处用旧判断 | reconcile，Session 仍为 ACTIVE |

- **真实进程。**
  - 带修复时 IT 跑了 4 次全部通过，每次约 7 秒。
  - 撤回池的改动后跑了 2 次全部失败，都失败在新增断言上：`DaemonHttpException: POST /session/:id/automations/operations failed with HTTP 404: {"error":"hosted_session_not_found",...}`。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

Linux x86_64，OpenJDK 25.0.2，Maven 3.9.9，Node 22，MySQL 8.4.6（Docker，`--disable-log-bin`），`dist/cli.js` 由 `a54bead374` 上的 `npm run bundle` 构建。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险或取舍。** 没有成员在接收时，获取型选择路径的所有调用方对 RELEASED 的 Session 都会得到 503，而不再到达已排空的原属主。这包括 fire、Turn、生命周期操作和事件流。这些调用在原属主那里以前同样无法得到服务：
  - 原属主已丢掉该 Session；
  - 它不在接收时会拒绝加载；
  - Store 会以 `harness_placement_released` 拒绝在已释放 placement 上的过期获取，IT 断言了这一点。

  容忍 404 的生命周期调用，例如 Harness 的 close 和生命周期 detach，以前在已排空的原属主上会"成功"，尽管它并不持有该 Session。现在它们会作为池等待，等到有成员开始接收，并为这次操作接管该 Session，也就是 `takeoverForLifecycle` 本来就提供的交接。
- **未验证 / 不在范围内。**
  - 已经被退役的镜像不会被修复。
  - 公共路由的 `409 harness_owner_still_live` 由 #15666 跟踪。
  - 在 release 提交前一刻读到 QUIESCING placement 的调用，仍可能在原属主丢掉该 Session 之后才到达，得到 404。扫描器现在会对此推迟。其他调用方，例如 Turn 和公共自动化路由，处理方式不变。
  - Session 仍为 ACTIVE 时，遇到这种 not-found 的手动 run 现在会返回路由的错误码，这与 `hosted_session_blocked` 等其他非定论 4xx 拒绝已有的行为一致。它的 claim 保持 firing，由扫描器重驱。以前这次 run 会被跳过，定义随之退役。公共路由如何映射这些错误码属于 #15666 的问题。
  - 如果 Session 一直是 ACTIVE 而 not-found 持续出现，定义保持 live，不会退役：每次 fire 的 claim 推迟到尝试上限后记为 `unknown`。
  - Harness 发起 release 后，连接器的 attachment 缓存条目仍然保留。本改动后，RELEASED 的 Session 不会再被路由到原属主，而接管会把 placement 移到新的 epoch，所以这条路径碰不到那个条目。
  - nightly 的 Hosted 任务会跑这个 IT，PR 上不跑。
- **破坏性变更 / 迁移说明。** 无，没有 API 或契约变更。

prs.title: fix(cli): bind the PR badge when a --flag is glued to the number
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Teaches the session PR registration grammar to accept a PR number with a command flag glued directly onto it — `/verify-pr 15979--publish` typed without the separating space. The tolerance is granted to `/verify-pr` only: it takes no file-path argument, and the admitted tail must be flag-shaped (a letter-led flag name, an optional `=value`, then whitespace or end). `/review` keeps its strict number closure because `/review <file-path>` is a documented invocation form and an extension-less path (`42--notes`) is indistinguishable from a glued flag — the regex encodes the tail shape, the parser owns the per-command policy. The repository-qualifier detector recognizes the glued `--repo` spelling anywhere in the command's own glued flag chain (`77--repo`, `77--publish--repo`, `77--repo--publish`), anchored to the command position so that prose digits never decline a legitimate bare binding; a missing, empty (`=`), or next-line qualifier value declines exactly as in the spaced form. A `/review` prompt whose bare token is a glued file path still binds any PR its URL names — the policy rejection falls through to a shared URL arm. The same grammar serves both the live prompt-admission bind and the transcript backfill sweep, and existing sessions that typed the glued form earn their badge retroactively on the next sweep without re-issuing the command.

## Why it's needed

Measured incident: two verification sessions were launched with `/verify-pr 15979--publish` and `/verify-pr 15978--publish` (missing space). The skill itself ran to completion because the model reads the argument semantically, but the daemon-side badge registration is a strict syntactic scan: its number token closed against `-`, so both prompts matched nothing and neither session ever received a PR sidecar or badge. The user-visible result was a silent split — the work happened, the badge never appeared, and nothing logged why.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the registration suite from the CLI package directory: `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/routes/session-pr-backfill.test.ts` — 175 tests pass. The pins cover six rounds: the glued-flag bind on both entry points; the glued `--repo` qualifier (missing, empty `=`, and next-line values decline with `repoDeclined`; readable own-repo values bind in both space and `=` spellings; foreign values decline); the flag-shaped-tail boundary (double-dash file names, digit tails, a lone `--`, and extension-less paths bind nothing, asserted on both commands); prose immunity (dotted, quoted, and line-final digit-glued `--repo` mentions do not decline a bare binding); the flag chain plus URL rescue (`--repo` chained after another glued flag declines in every unreadable-value shape and in reverse order, a readable chained value binds, and a `/review` glued file path with a pull URL still binds the URL's PR); and the anchored gap plus one link grammar (a URL on a later line or behind a quote binds nothing, and `--repo` after a valued glued link like `--publish=x` declines exactly like the value-free chain — the number tail and the qualifier chain are composed from a single shared link constant). The pre-existing file-path pins (`001_init.sql`, `2026-08-25-notes.md`) stay green.

Every round was mutation-witnessed red→green on the pre-fix head, including vacuity witnesses for the guards themselves: deleting the per-command policy check turns the extension-less pin red; un-anchoring the qualifier arm turns the prose pins red; deleting the `=` boundary turns the empty-value pins red; deleting the chain group turns the chained pins red; deleting the URL fallback turns the URL-rescue pins red; widening the tail body turns the tolerance-holder's exclusion pins red; un-anchoring the URL fallback turns the later-line/quoted pins red; deleting the shared link's `=value` arm turns the valued-chain pins red. A 33-shape adversarial matrix (tabs, CRLF, `#N`, chained/reverse-order/valued qualifiers, `--assets-repo` links, single-dash values, ten-digit, unicode digits, all three URL placements) and 16 KiB pathological-tail / 2000-link valued-chain timing probes (≤0.1 ms; the shared link grammar keeps every partition unique after two measured catastrophic-backtracking findings) were also checked directly against the shipped patterns.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — daemon-side registration logic, no TUI change. Before: the two incident prompts return no match and no sidecar is written. After: both bind their numbers, and the next backfill sweep repairs the two existing sessions from their unchanged transcripts.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only (vitest, mocked GitHub backend). ESLint, Prettier, and the CLI type check pass locally.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: `/verify-pr 42--notes` binds PR 42 by design — the command has no file-path form, so a glued letter-led tail can only be a flag typo, and tolerating it is the point of the fix. `/review` grants no glued tolerance at all, closing the file-path forgery class for both dotted and extension-less names. The `=value` tail arm (needed for glued `--repo=<url>`) means a contrived `/verify-pr 42--x=y.md` also binds; no documented invocation produces that shape.
- Not validated / out of scope: the URL invocation form with a flag glued onto the URL itself is untouched (pre-existing behavior); real-daemon retroactive sweep is described in the local E2E plan but was verified at the function level with the production entry points, not against a live GitHub workspace.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — the change only widens what binds for `/verify-pr`; no sidecar shape, route, or setting changes.

## Linked Issues

None.

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

在 CLI 包目录下运行注册套件：`cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/routes/session-pr-backfill.test.ts`——175 个测试通过。钉覆盖六轮：两个入口的粘连 flag 绑定；粘连 `--repo` 限定（缺失值、空 `=` 值、跨行值以 `repoDeclined` 拒绝；本仓可读值在空格与 `=` 两种拼写下绑定；外仓值拒绝）；flag 形状尾部边界（双连字符文件名、数字尾、孤立 `--`、无扩展名路径一律不绑定，两个命令都断言）；正文免疫（带点、引号包裹、行尾的数字粘连 `--repo` 提及不误拒裸绑定）；flag 链与 URL 兜底（`--repo` 链在其他粘连 flag 之后时所有不可读值形态及逆序都拒绝，可读链式值绑定，带 pull URL 的 `/review` 粘连文件路径仍绑定 URL 的 PR）；锚定 gap 与单一链节语法（跨行或引号内的 URL 一律不绑定，`--publish=x` 这类带值链节之后的 `--repo` 与无值链一样拒绝——编号尾部与限定链由同一个共享链节常量组合而成）。既有文件名钉（`001_init.sql`、`2026-08-25-notes.md`）保持绿。

每一轮都在修复前的 head 上做了红→绿变异见证，含守卫自身的空性见证：删除按命令策略检查使无扩展名钉变红；解除限定臂锚定使正文钉变红；删除 `=` 边界使空值钉变红；删除链组使链式钉变红；删除 URL 兜底使 URL 救援钉变红；加宽尾部使容忍持有者的排除钉变红；解除 URL 兜底锚定使跨行/引号钉变红；删除共享链节的 `=value` 使带值链钉变红。另用 33 例对抗矩阵（制表符、CRLF、`#N`、链式/逆序/带值限定、`--assets-repo` 链节、单连字符值、十位数字、Unicode 数字、三种 URL 位置）与 16KiB 病态尾部 / 2000 节带值长链计时探针（≤0.1ms；共享链节语法在两次实测灾难性回溯后保持所有划分唯一）直接对照 shipped 正则核验。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A——daemon 侧注册逻辑，无 TUI 变化。之前：两条事故提示词无匹配、不写 sidecar。之后：两者都绑定其数字，且下一次 backfill 扫描会从原封不动的转录修复这两个存量会话。

### 测试平台

macOS ✅（单测、ESLint、Prettier、类型检查均本地通过）；Windows / Linux 未本地测试（由 CI 覆盖）。

- 主要风险/权衡：`/verify-pr 42--notes` 按设计绑定 PR 42——该命令没有文件路径形式，粘连的字母开头尾部只能是 flag 笔误，容忍它正是修复的目的。`/review` 完全不授予粘连容忍，对带点与无扩展名文件名都关闭了文件路径伪造类。`=值` 尾部分支（粘连 `--repo=<url>` 所必需）意味着刻意构造的 `/verify-pr 42--x=y.md` 也会绑定；没有文档化调用会产生该形态。

prs.title: refactor(managed-agent): extract the execution observation cooldown
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Opens P1 (the god-class decomposition) with the first and lowest-risk internal seam of the Runtime Broker service: the UNKNOWN-execution lookup cooldown moves out of the 6,400-line service into a package-private `ExecutionObservationCooldown`. The collaborator owns the only state it touches — the cooled-entry map — and shares the service's clock and scheduler, so it has no lifecycle of its own. The lookup read path (settled-answer replay, fresher-UNKNOWN merge) and the stamp/eviction path move verbatim with their comments; the service keeps the stamp-before-in-flight-slot-drop ordering that prevents sequential observers from fanning through to the worker. The one-second window constant moves with the logic, and the test-access seam follows it. Eight new unit tests cover the extracted class directly, including deterministic eviction proofs (captured task, no wall-clock sleep) that rewind the clock to distinguish eviction from expiry and pin the same-clock invariant from both sides.

## Why it's needed

The accepted structure design names four collaborators to extract from this service — recovery scanning, cancellation, tool holds, and observation cooldown — before it becomes a facade. The cooldown is the only one that touches no shared mutable state beyond its own map and no CAS/lease core, which makes it the safe first cut that establishes the extraction pattern. Each remaining collaborator follows as its own slice, keeping every diff reviewable and independently revertable.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm the move is behavior-free: the cooled-read and stamp logic in the new class is the former inline logic verbatim (comments included), the service's `lookupOnce` still stamps before dropping the in-flight slot, and `close()` is unchanged (the cooldown never had its own shutdown). Then run from `packages/managed-agent-server` with JDK 21:

```
mvn -Dtest='ExecutionObservationCooldownTest,Issue13183RegressionTest,Issue13183AdversarialTest,RuntimeBrokerServiceTest,RuntimeBrokerHttpServerTest,ModuleArchitectureTest' test checkstyle:check
```

Expected: 282 tests green (8 unit + 199 broker service + 43 HTTP server + 25 Issue13183 regression + 6 Issue13183 adversarial + 1 ArchUnit), zero Checkstyle violations across all seven modules. The full H2 suite, SpotBugs, MySQL integration and Hosted/fault profiles run in CI.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — internal refactor with no user-visible surface change.

Local results (JDK 21.0.9, isolated task repository):

```

ModuleArchitectureTest:            Tests run: 1,   Failures: 0, Errors: 0
[INFO] You have 0 Checkstyle violations.   (all 7 modules)
[INFO] BUILD SUCCESS
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  N/A   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

JDK 21.0.9, Maven 3.9.11, task-isolated local repository hardlink-seeded from the warm cache. H2/unit paths only locally; real MySQL and Hosted paths are CI-owned.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: extracting from a lease/CAS-heavy service. Mitigation: this seam touches none of that core — one private map, one clock, one shared scheduler — and the 199-test integrated broker suite plus the 43-test HTTP suite prove behavior is unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: full H2 suite, SpotBugs, MySQL integration, Hosted/fault profiles are CI-owned and pending. The other three collaborators (recovery scanning, cancellation, tool holds) and the `ManagedAgentStore` aggregate split are explicitly follow-up slices, recorded in the design.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — the collaborator is package-private; the public service surface, HTTP API, OpenAPI file and schema are untouched.

prs.title: feat(autofix-pr): leave a check for a person once three fix pushes left it red
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds the last budget the `/autofix-pr` design still listed as a proposal: how many of the watch's own pushes a failing check may stay red across. When a round reads the PR, the snapshot helper records in the watch's state file each check it saw fail and has not seen pass since, and counts the watch's pushes it failed on. After three, the check's failure is marked as spent and the skill answers it as needing a human instead of handing it to the fix agent again: it is listed under the round's own items, recorded as handled on that head, and shown by `/autofix-pr status` with the other items waiting for a person. The watch itself goes on, still answering review feedback and the other checks. A pass ends the record, so the check's next failure is fixed again.

The gate never wakes a round for a pass, so a round may never see one: the watch can push again for a review comment before its fix's checks finish, and a re-run can pass after the round has moved on. So when a recorded check fails on a later push of the watch, the snapshot asks GitHub directly — one read-only GraphQL read of a commit's check rollup — what the check ended in on the watch's pushes in between that were not counted, and on the head it last failed on when a round re-ran it there. A pass there ends the record just as a pass a round reads does, so the failure after it counts as a first one; a failure on a push in between spends a push. A head with no result spends nothing. One that may still get one — still running, a re-run GitHub has not listed yet, not listed while the commit's other checks still run, or no answer — stays on the record (at most ten) and is asked about again on the record's next push: a pass found there later gives back the pushes counted before it, and a failure found there spends nothing. One that ended with no result (cancelled, skipped, or not listed once the commit's checks have all ended) is dropped, and a re-run only held for a run still going is not asked about: it starts on its own head only, which the counted push has left. These reads happen only in that case, at most four commits per read, shared by every check, newest first and each once, with every record's re-run, then its pushes in between, asked before any head asked about again; in the usual fix-then-fail loop there are none.

Someone else's push gives every check its pushes back: `sync` and `prepare` do so when they adopt one, whether or not a round ever reads it (a push the fix agent merged in before the watch pushed, say). A return to an earlier push of the watch spends nothing, only a read of the head the watch knows counts (any other is the API lagging, or a push the round re-syncs to), a rollup cut at the page limit — the head's or a looked-up commit's — is taken for no answer, and a workflow GitHub could not start is never marked (it already goes to a human). Only a read that changes a record takes the watch's lock, re-reading the state under it, so a merged PR is still answered while another helper holds the lock. The record follows the watch through a take-over, a resume and a recreated worktree; a new start begins without it, as the push budget does. The user guide's limits table and both language versions of the command design are updated, including the delivery note that marked this budget as still to come.

## Why it's needed

A watch offered a failing check to the fix agent again on every new head. A check the agent could not actually make pass was bounded only by the ten pushes per watch, so in the worst case the PR received ten pushes and ten round summaries, and the session paid for ten fix rounds, before anything stopped. The design table already named a budget of three fix attempts per failing check, but no helper recorded which checks passed, so it stayed a proposal.

The budget leaves the check for a person rather than stopping the whole watch, which is what the design table originally said: stopping on one hopeless check would also end the handling of review comments and of every other check. Counting from what GitHub says about the watch's own pushes, rather than from what rounds happened to read, keeps the budget from firing early when a fix did pass unseen, and from being reset by every review comment on an active PR.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Unit, from `packages/cli`: `npx vitest run src/commands/autofix-pr/` — 17 files, 542 tests, all passing (the new `snapshot.fix-budget.test.ts` has 53). ## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: one more GitHub read in the case it is needed (a recorded check failing on a later push with uncounted pushes before it, after a re-run, or with heads an earlier read got no result for), capped at four commits per read; an unanswered read spends nothing and is asked again on the next push, so the budget leans toward offering a check again rather than handing it over early. Heads someone else pushed reset the count by design: a person working on the branch gets the watch's help again.
- Not validated / out of scope: a full model-driven watch that spends three pushes on a real PR (three real pushes and replies); of the heads a read got no result for, at most ten are kept for a later read, and a result found later can only give pushes back. The budget is not carried across a new start (as the push budget is not), and an `--in-place` start, one round each, never reaches it.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The state file gains an optional `failingChecks` list, and a snapshot event an optional `exhausted` flag; the gate output is unchanged. An older CLI reading a state file written by this one ignores the list.

## 这个 PR 做什么

补上 `/autofix-pr` 设计里最后一个仍停留在提议阶段的预算:一个失败检查可以在监视自己的多少次推送之后仍是红的。每一轮读取 PR 时,snapshot helper 把它看到失败、此后还没看到通过的每个检查记进监视的状态文件,并统计它在监视的几次推送上失败。满三次后,这个检查的失败被标为已用完,skill 把它作为需要人工处理来回答,不再交给修复 agent:它列在本轮自己的事项里,在该 head 上记为已处理,并和其他待人处理的事项一起由 `/autofix-pr status` 显示。监视本身继续运行,照常处理评审反馈和其他检查。一次通过就结束这条记录,之后再失败会重新修复。

闸门从不因为通过而唤醒任何一轮,所以通过可能没有哪一轮读到:监视可能在修复的检查跑完前又为评审评论推送了一次,重跑也可能在这一轮往下走之后才通过。所以当已记录的检查在监视之后的推送上失败时,snapshot 会直接问 GitHub——一次只读的 GraphQL 读取,读一个提交的检查 rollup——它在中间这些未计入的监视推送上的结果,以及某一轮在它最后失败的 head 上重跑过时,在那个 head 上的结果。那里通过,就像某一轮读到通过一样结束这条记录,其后的失败算作第一次;中间某次推送上失败则消耗一次推送。没有结果的 head 不消耗。之后还可能有结果的——仍在运行、GitHub 还没列出的重跑、该提交其他检查仍在运行时尚未列出的,或没有回应——留在记录上(最多 10 个),在该记录的下一次推送时再问:之后查到通过,则归还它之前计入的次数;查到失败则不消耗。已经结束却没有结果的(被取消、被跳过,或该提交的检查全部结束后仍未列出)被丢弃;只为仍在进行的 run 延后的重跑不会被查询:它只在自己的 head 上发起,而被计入的那次推送已经离开了那个 head。只有这种情况才会读取,每次最多 4 个提交,由所有检查共用,从最新的问起,每个只读一次,先问各条的重跑,再问中间推送,最后才问需要再问的 head;通常的「修复后又失败」循环里一次也不需要。

别人的推送让每个检查拿回推送次数:`sync` 和 `prepare` 采纳别人的推送时就这样做,不论之后有没有哪一轮读到它(比如修复 agent 在监视推送前合并进来的推送)。回到监视更早的推送不消耗;只有读到监视已知的 head 才计数(其他的要么是 API 滞后,要么是这一轮会重新同步过去的推送);在页数上限处被截断的 rollup(head 的,或被查询提交的)按没有回应处理;GitHub 没能启动的 workflow 永远不会被标记(它本来就交给人)。只有改变了记录的读取才会加监视的锁,并在锁内重新读取状态,所以另一个 helper 持锁时,已合并的 PR 照样能得到回答。接管、resume 和重建 worktree 都保留这条记录;新的启动不带它,与推送预算一致。用户指南的限制表和命令设计文档的中英两版都已更新,包括原先把这项预算标为「尚未完成」的交付说明。

## 为什么需要

以前,监视在每个新 head 上都会把失败检查再交给修复 agent。修复 agent 实际修不好的检查,只受「每个监视 10 次推送」限制,最坏情况下 PR 会收到 10 次推送和 10 条轮次汇总,会话也要为 10 轮修复付费,之后才会停下。设计表里早就写了「每个失败检查 3 次修复尝试」,但没有任何 helper 记录哪些检查通过了,所以一直只是提议。

用完时这里选择把检查留给人,而不是像设计表原来写的那样停止整个监视:为一个修不好的检查停掉监视,会连带停掉评审评论和其他所有检查的处理。按 GitHub 对监视自己推送的结果来计数,而不是按各轮碰巧读到的内容,既不会在修复其实已悄悄通过时过早触发,也不会在活跃的 PR 上被每条评审评论重置。

auto_merge.commit_message:
* feat(autofix-pr): leave a check for a person once three fix pushes left it red

A watch fixed a failing check again on every new head, so a check the fix
agent could not make pass was bounded only by the ten pushes per watch.
Prepared snapshots now record each check a round saw fail and has not seen
pass since, and count the watch's own later pushes it failed on. After
three, the check's ci_failed carries exhausted: true and the skill answers
it as needing a human instead of fixing it; the watch keeps going for
review feedback and the other checks.

The gate wakes no round for a pass, so when a recorded check fails on a
later push of the watch, the snapshot asks GitHub what it ended in on the
watch's pushes in between, and on the head it last failed on when a round
re-ran it there: a pass there starts the count over. Someone else's push
gives every check its pushes back, in sync when it adopts one; a return to
an earlier push of the watch spends nothing; only a read of the head the
watch knows counts, and only a read that changes the record takes the
watch's lock.

* fix(autofix-pr): keep unanswered heads for the fix budget and skip cut rollups

A read whose head rollup is cut at the page limit no longer changes the
fix budget: a later run of a check may sit on the pages not read, so a
visible old failure could spend a push and a visible old pass could
drop the record.

A head the count asked about and got no result for (a re-run still
going, a cancelled or unlisted run, GitHub not answering, or a head past
the lookup budget) now stays on the record, the newest four, and is
asked again on the record's next push. A pass found there later leaves
only the pushes counted since a round next saw the check fail; a
failure found there spends nothing.

A pass a lookup finds now ends the record as a pass a round reads does,
so the failure after it is a first one again, instead of restarting the
count and still spending for the failing head and the failures in
between after the pass.

prepare now records the head through withKnownHead, so recreating a
worktree at someone else's push gives every check its pushes back at
the write, as sync does.

* fix(autofix-pr): keep only heads that may still answer, and take review follow-ups

The fix budget now tells a head whose check is still running from one
where it ended with no result. A check run not completed, a pending
status, a re-run GitHub has not listed yet (no check run after the floor
rerunChecks recorded), or a check not listed while other checks of the
commit still run is pending, and stays on the record with heads GitHub
did not answer about. A cancelled or skipped run, or a check not listed
once the commit's checks have all ended, is dropped, so it cannot hold a
slot or a lookup forever. Before, a re-run not listed yet was read as
having failed again, and its later pass was never asked about. A re-run
only held for a run still going is not asked about: it starts on its own
head only, which the counted push has left.

Each read asks every record's re-run, then its pushes in between newest
first, before any head it asks about again, so a re-ask never takes the
lookup a push in between needs. A record keeps at most as many
unanswered heads as a watch has pushes, so a re-run head is no longer
the first one dropped. A round seeing a head fail on a return to it
drops that head, so a late pass after a rollback counts as an answer at
once would.

Review follow-ups: the stale-base design names the exhausted condition,
the lock paragraph lists snapshot, the Section 10 row and the action
precedence say a check out of fix pushes leaves the watch running, and
tests now pin the sync --discard reset, the stale-base hint beside a
spent check, the per-identity exhausted mark, both early returns under
the lock, and the order of records a read leaves as they were.

---------

prs.title: test(managed-agent): unwrap the connector decorator in the Hosted attachment lookup
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The Hosted gates read two private fields off the `HarnessConnector` bean — the Session attachment map and the harness client. Both reads now go through one shared resolver that walks the connector's delegate chain to whichever connector actually owns that state, instead of reflecting straight off the bean they are handed. Resolving once and sharing it is the point: the first revision of this PR unwrapped only the map read, which let the row get one line further and then die on the client read instead.

The same decorator also broke a lookup that did not use reflection at all: the pool gate asked Spring for the concrete `HarnessPoolConnector`, and the bean is the boundary wrapping it, so the lookup found no bean and that nightly row died before its own assertions. It now resolves the owner through the same helper and casts the result. The resolver already stops at a connector that owns no attachment map, which is exactly the pool's shape, so this needed no new logic — only visibility, since that gate lives in the `harness` subpackage. The support class and that one method are now public; everything else in the class stays package-private, and the shared-helpers design record is updated in both languages to say so. A sweep of the whole module confirms no concrete-type connector `getBean` remains.

The walk is by field shape — it looks for a `delegate` of the connector type — rather than by naming today's decorator, so a future wrapper does not silently reintroduce the break. A chain that owns no map still falls through to the original Spring error, which names the missing field, so the failure mode for a genuinely absent map is unchanged.

This is a test-support change only. No production class, contract, wiring or schema is touched.

## Why it's needed

The nightly Hosted fault lane is broken across many unrelated rows. In [run 41109000007](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41109000007) the job reports 31 distinct failing tests, and a large share of them never reach their own assertions — they die in the test-support layer with:

```
java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Could not find field 'attachments' on target object
  [com.alibaba.qwen.code.managedagent.harness.SdkHarnessBoundary@1b8a6ae2]
    at org.springframework.test.util.ReflectionTestUtils.getField(ReflectionTestUtils.java:278)
    at com.alibaba.qwen.code.managedagent.HostedGateTestSupport.attachment(HostedGateTestSupport.java:378)
```

The bean is a decorator. #15871 changed the wiring from returning the concrete connector to returning `new SdkHarnessBoundary(connector)`, and the boundary holds the real connector in a private `delegate` field while owning no `attachments` map of its own. That commit also touched the shared helper, but only to move imports between the new modules — the reflection was left reading a field that had moved one level down. The result is that every gate asking for an attachment fails before the row under test does anything, which is how a wrapping change passed its own pull-request CI and broke the nightly: the lookup only runs in the Hosted gates, and pull requests get the tier that skips them.

Comparing against the run behind #15892 shows this is a new break, not new coverage: 15 of that run's 16 distinct failures no longer fail, and 30 different ones now do, across eight classes that all already existed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The check is that a decorated connector yields the same answer the concrete one always did, and that nothing else about the lookup changed.

Five new tests in the helper's existing surefire-lane test class. The first two wrap a connector **twice**, so a single unwrap would not pass; the other three pin the resolver's defensive branches and its null-delegate fallback, one each.

The first asserts the Session's own ref comes back identical, an unknown Session still returns null, and the map returned by the shared lookup is the *same instance* the connector holds. The last one matters because a call site clears that map to simulate a cold dispatcher cache — returning a copy would silently stop simulating anything.

The second covers the client read on the same decorated bean: it seeds a client, reads it back through the shared resolver, and asserts identity. An earlier revision also nullled the client and asserted the read returned null; review pointed out that assertion could not fail, because the walk resolves by field *declaration* and never reads a value, so it was removed rather than left as coverage it does not provide.

The fifth test covers what that assertion was reaching for: a delegate that is itself null. The walk then runs off its end, and without a fallback `getField(null, …)` complains about the missing target instead of naming the field the caller asked for. The resolver falls back to the connector it started from, and the test asserts the error still names `attachments`.

One dependency behaviour the resolver relies on was measured rather than assumed, against the spring-core the build actually resolves: `ReflectionUtils.findField(clazz, name, type)` matches the **declared type exactly**, not by assignability, so asking for the connector interface would miss a `delegate` declared as a concrete connector. The resolver therefore matches on the name and checks assignability itself. The same measurement confirms a field that exists and holds null is still found, which is what makes the null-client case above a read rather than a failure.

That test lives in the default surefire lane on purpose. The helper's existing comment says these helpers are shared by nine Hosted classes whose only lane needs MySQL and the Harness, so pinning them here keeps a wrong edit red in the fast lane instead of the slowest CI job. This break is exactly the case that comment was written for, and the pin now covers decoration as well as renaming.

The remaining two tests exist because review showed the resolver's defensive branches were unpinned: swapping the assignability check for an exact type comparison, or deleting the null-delegate stop, left the whole class green. One test uses a decorator that declares its `delegate` as the concrete connector rather than the interface, so only a name-plus-assignability match walks past it. The other ends a chain at a connector owning neither field — the shape of the pooled connector — and asserts the walk stops there and the lookup still fails naming `attachments`, rather than dereferencing past the end.

Three mutation checks, each run separately so the attribution is not shared.

With the walk removed, four tests fail — the two field reads error with the nightly's message for their own field, and the two owner-identity assertions fail because the walk stopped at the decorator. The other eleven pass:

```
HostedGateTestSupportTest.attachmentUnwrapsTheBoundaryToTheConnectorThatOwnsTheMap
  ERROR — IllegalArgumentException: Could not find field 'attachments' on target
  object [...harness.SdkHarnessBoundary@630e5010]
HostedGateTestSupportTest.connectorOwningServesEveryPrivateReadOnTheDecoratedBean
  ERROR — IllegalArgumentException: Could not find field 'client' on target
  object [...harness.SdkHarnessBoundary@74e175c7]
Tests run: 15, Failures: 2, Errors: 2
```

With the assignability check replaced by `type == field.getType()`, only the concrete-delegate test fails, on its `connectorOwning(decorated)` identity assertion at line 123 — the walk stopped at the decorator instead of reaching the connector:

```
HostedGateTestSupportTest.theWalkFollowsADelegateDeclaredAsAConcreteConnector:123
Tests run: 15, Failures: 1, Errors: 0
```

With the `delegate == null` stop deleted, only the no-owner-chain test fails, and it fails as the NPE the stop exists to prevent:

```
HostedGateTestSupportTest.aChainThatOwnsNoMapStopsAndStillNamesTheMissingField
  ERROR — NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "java.lang.reflect.Field.getModifiers()"
  because "field" is null
Tests run: 15, Failures: 0, Errors: 1
```

Applying both branch mutants at once kills both tests but reports the same NPE for each, which is why they were run separately.

Local results, JDK 21.0.9 and Maven 3.9.11, task-isolated repository, sibling SDK installed from the same tree:

```
mvn -Dtest=HostedGateTestSupportTest,ModuleArchitectureTest \
    -DfailIfNoSpecifiedTests=false test checkstyle:check
Tests run: 16, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0
0 Checkstyle violations in all 8 modules; BUILD SUCCESS
```

The full build also compiles every Hosted gate against the changed helper signature, so the second call site is verified to compile even though its rows need MySQL and a Harness to execute.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible surface. The observable change is that Hosted gate rows reach their own assertions again instead of erroring in test support; the failure text above is the before, and the mutation run reproduces it exactly.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Maven only. No MySQL, Harness process or broker was provisioned, so the Hosted rows themselves were not executed locally — see the scope note below.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the walk follows any `delegate` field of the connector type, so a connector that both lacks an `attachments` map and delegates to something unexpected would be followed rather than reported. It stops at the first connector that owns the map, and a chain that owns none still produces the original Spring error naming the field, so the worst case is the same clear failure as today rather than a silent wrong answer. A null delegate exits the walk instead of throwing a NullPointerException.
- Not validated / out of scope: the Hosted rows themselves. They need a provisioned MySQL 8.4 and a real Harness process, which is the approval-gated full tier; locally only the helper's surefire-lane pin and the architecture guard were run. **This does not claim to fix all 31 rows.** `HostedProcessCrashIT.processCrashesNeverReplayHostedToolsOnMySql` was already failing in the earlier run and has a separate cause, still tracked under #15892. Every other private-field read on a Spring-obtained connector was scanned for, not just the one review flagged: across all fourteen sites that resolve the bean, the only `getField` calls are the two this PR now routes through the resolver, and the remaining sites either call contract methods (which the decorator forwards) or pass the bean to the already-fixed lookup. So no further read of this kind is left on the bean — but rows can still fail for reasons unrelated to it, and those are not claimed here. The pooled configuration is also unchanged: `HarnessPoolConnector` owns no single attachment map and has no `delegate` field, so it produces the same clear error it did before the decorator existed — no regression, and no attempt to invent a pool-wide answer here.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Test sources only; no production, contract, schema or configuration change.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15972
Refs #15892 — the residual process-crash row and the runner disk condition stay tracked there.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

Hosted 门禁会从 `HarnessConnector` bean 上读两个私有字段——Session 的 attachment map 与 harness client。这两处读取现在都走同一个共享解析器，由它沿 connector 的 delegate 链走到真正持有这些状态的那一个，而不是直接对拿到的 bean 反射。解析一次、两处共享正是要点：本 PR 第一版只解了 map 那一处的包装，结果让那条行往前走了一行、然后死在 client 读取上。

同一个装饰器还打破了一处根本不用反射的查找：pool 门禁向 Spring 要具体的 `HarnessPoolConnector`，而 bean 是包着它的 boundary，于是查不到 bean，那条 nightly 行在走到自己的断言之前就死了。它现在改为经同一个 helper 解析 owner 再强转。解析器本来就会停在「不持有 attachment map」的 connector 上，而那正是 pool 的形状，所以这里不需要新逻辑——只需要可见性，因为那条门禁在 `harness` 子包里。支撑类与这一个方法现在是 public，类里其余成员仍为包级私有，共享 helper 的设计记录已双语更新说明这一点。对全模块的扫描确认：已不再有任何按具体 connector 类型取 bean 的查找。

走链是按**字段形状**——找 connector 类型的 `delegate` 字段——而不是点名今天这个装饰器，所以未来再加包装不会静默地把问题带回来。若整条链都没有该 map，仍会落到 Spring 原本那个点名缺失字段的报错，因此「map 真的不存在」时的失败形态不变。

这只是测试支撑改动。没有触碰任何生产类、契约、wiring 或 schema。

## 为什么需要

nightly 的 Hosted 故障车道在许多互不相关的行上一起坏掉。在 [run 41109000007](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41109000007) 中该 job 报 31 个不同失败测试，其中很大一部分根本没走到自己的断言——它们死在测试支撑层：

```
java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Could not find field 'attachments' on target object
  [com.alibaba.qwen.code.managedagent.harness.SdkHarnessBoundary@1b8a6ae2]
    at org.springframework.test.util.ReflectionTestUtils.getField(ReflectionTestUtils.java:278)
    at com.alibaba.qwen.code.managedagent.HostedGateTestSupport.attachment(HostedGateTestSupport.java:378)
```

那个 bean 是个装饰器。#15871 把 wiring 从返回具体 connector 改成返回 `new SdkHarnessBoundary(connector)`，而 boundary 把真正的 connector 放在私有 `delegate` 字段里，自身没有 `attachments` map。该提交也动了这个共享 helper，但只是在新模块之间搬 import——反射被留在原地，读一个已经下移一层的字段。结果就是每一条查询 attachment 的门禁都在被测行做任何事之前失败；这也解释了一个包装改动为什么能通过自己 PR 的 CI 却打破 nightly：该查询只在 Hosted 门禁里跑，而 PR 拿到的正是跳过它们的那一层。

与 #15892 背后那次运行对比可见这是新破损、不是新增覆盖：那次 16 个不同失败里 15 个已不再失败，取而代之的是 30 个新的，分布在八个早就存在的类里。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

要确认的是：被装饰的 connector 给出与具体 connector 一贯相同的答案，且查询的其他行为未变。

helper 既有 surefire 车道测试类里新增五条。前两条把 connector **包了两层**，所以只解一次包装不会通过；后三条各钉住解析器的一条防御分支或它的 null-delegate 回退。

第一条断言：该 Session 自己的 ref 原样返回、未知 Session 仍返回 null、共享查询返回的 map 与 connector 持有的是**同一个实例**。最后一条很重要，因为有一个调用点会 clear 这个 map 来模拟 dispatcher 缓存冷启动——返回副本会让这个模拟静默失效。

第二条覆盖同一个被装饰 bean 上的 client 读取：先种入一个 client，经共享解析器读回并断言同一实例。早先一版还把 client 设为 null 并断言读回 null；评审指出那条断言不可能失败——走链是按字段**是否声明**解析的，从不读取值——所以把它删掉，而不是留着一份它并不提供的覆盖。

第五条测试覆盖的正是那条断言想表达的东西：delegate 自身为 null。此时走链会走出末端，若没有回退，`getField(null, …)` 会抱怨缺少 target，而不是点名调用方要的字段。解析器回退到出发时的那个 connector，测试断言报错仍点名 `attachments`。

解析器依赖的一个依赖行为是实测的、不是假定的，对着构建实际解析到的 spring-core 验证：`ReflectionUtils.findField(clazz, name, type)` 按**声明类型精确匹配**，不是按可赋值匹配，所以用 connector 接口去找一个声明为具体 connector 的 `delegate` 会找不到。因此解析器改为按名字找、自己判断可赋值。同一次实测也确认「字段存在但值为 null」仍会被找到，这正是上面 null-client 那格属于一次读取而不是一次失败的原因。

这条测试刻意放在默认 surefire 车道。helper 原有注释就写着：这些 helper 被九个 Hosted 类共享，而它们唯一的车道需要 MySQL 与 Harness，所以在这里钉住能让错误改动在快车道变红，而不是在最慢的 CI job 里。这次破损正是那条注释所针对的情形，现在这个钉子同时覆盖了「装饰」与「重命名」。

另外两条测试的由来是评审指出解析器的防御分支没有被钉住：把可赋值判断换成精确类型比较、或删掉 null-delegate 停止分支，整个测试类都仍然全绿。其中一条用一个把 `delegate` 声明为具体 connector（而非接口）的装饰器，因此只有「按名 + 可赋值」匹配才能越过它。另一条让链终止在一个两个字段都不持有的 connector 上——池化 connector 就是这个形状——断言走链停在那里、查询仍以点名 `attachments` 失败，而不是越过链尾去解引用。

三次变异验证，各自单独跑，因此归因不共享。

去掉走链后有四条失败——两处字段读取各自以 nightly 里对应自己那个字段的原话报错，两条 owner 同一实例断言则因走链停在装饰器而失败。其余十一条通过：

```
HostedGateTestSupportTest.attachmentUnwrapsTheBoundaryToTheConnectorThatOwnsTheMap
  ERROR — IllegalArgumentException: Could not find field 'attachments' on target
  object [...harness.SdkHarnessBoundary@630e5010]
HostedGateTestSupportTest.connectorOwningServesEveryPrivateReadOnTheDecoratedBean
  ERROR — IllegalArgumentException: Could not find field 'client' on target
  object [...harness.SdkHarnessBoundary@74e175c7]
Tests run: 15, Failures: 2, Errors: 2
```

把可赋值判断换成 `type == field.getType()` 后，只有「具体类型 delegate」那条失败：

```
HostedGateTestSupportTest.theWalkFollowsADelegateDeclaredAsAConcreteConnector:123
  FAILURE — connectorOwning returned the decorator instead of the connector
Tests run: 15, Failures: 1, Errors: 0
```

删掉 `delegate == null` 停止分支后，只有「无 owner 链」那条失败，且正是该分支要防的那个 NPE：

```
HostedGateTestSupportTest.aChainThatOwnsNoMapStopsAndStillNamesTheMissingField
  ERROR — NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "java.lang.reflect.Field.getModifiers()"
  because "field" is null
Tests run: 15, Failures: 0, Errors: 1
```

两个分支变异同时施加会杀死两条测试，但两条都报同一个 NPE，所以才分开各跑一次。

本地结果，JDK 21.0.9 + Maven 3.9.11，任务隔离仓库，兄弟 SDK 从同一棵树安装：

```
mvn -Dtest=HostedGateTestSupportTest,ModuleArchitectureTest \
    -DfailIfNoSpecifiedTests=false test checkstyle:check
Tests run: 16, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0
8 个模块均 0 Checkstyle 违规；BUILD SUCCESS
```

完整构建也会对着改动后的 helper 签名编译每一个 Hosted 门禁，所以第二个调用点即使其行需要 MySQL 与 Harness 才能执行，也已被验证可编译。

### 证据（改动前后）

N/A —— 没有用户可见界面。可观测变化是 Hosted 门禁各行重新走到自己的断言，而不是在测试支撑里报错；上面那段失败文本就是「改动前」，变异运行精确复现了它。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

仅 Maven。没有预置 MySQL、Harness 进程或 broker，因此 Hosted 各行本身未在本地执行——见下方范围说明。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：走链会跟随任何 connector 类型的 `delegate` 字段，所以一个既没有 `attachments` map、又 delegate 到意料之外对象的 connector 会被跟随而不是被报出。它在第一个持有该 map 的 connector 处停下，而整条链都没有时仍产生 Spring 原本点名该字段的报错，所以最坏情况是与今天同样清晰的失败，而不是静默给出错误答案。delegate 为 null 时退出走链，而不是抛 NullPointerException。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：Hosted 各行本身。它们需要预置 MySQL 8.4 与真实 Harness 进程，属需 approval 触发的 full tier；本地只跑了 helper 的 surefire 车道钉子与架构守卫。**本 PR 不声称修好全部 31 行。** `HostedProcessCrashIT.processCrashesNeverReplayHostedToolsOnMySql` 在更早那次运行里就已失败，另有原因，仍在 #15892 下跟踪。除评审指出的那一处之外，我扫了所有从 Spring 取 connector 后的私有字段读取：在全部十四个取该 bean 的位置里，`getField` 只有本 PR 现在交给解析器的那两处；其余位置要么调用契约方法（装饰器会转发），要么把 bean 传给已修好的查询。所以这个 bean 上不再留有这一类读取——但各行仍可能因与它无关的原因失败，那些不在本 PR 的声称范围内。池化配置同样不变：`HarnessPoolConnector` 既不持有单一 attachment map 也没有 `delegate` 字段，因此它产生的仍是装饰器存在之前那个清晰报错——无回归，也不在这里臆造一个池级答案。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。仅测试源码；没有生产、契约、schema 或配置改动。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #15972
Refs #15892 —— 残留的 process-crash 行与 runner 磁盘状况仍在那里跟踪。

</details>

prs.title: test(managed-agent): pin the OSS open retry on client timeouts
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Pins the retry classification of `AliyunToolPublicationObjectStore.read()`, the method behind every OSS tool-publication object open, in `AliyunToolPublicationObjectStoreTest`:

- **Every transient code is retried.** `everyTransientCodeIsRetried` fails the first `getObject` once with each member of `TRANSIENT_SERVICE_ERRORS` (`InternalError`, `ServiceUnavailable`) and `TRANSIENT_CLIENT_ERRORS` (`ConnectionTimeout`, `SocketTimeout`, `ConnectionRefused`, `UnknownHost`, `SocketException`, `SslException`), then returns the object, and asserts the read succeeds after exactly two calls.
- **The timeout the configuration reference names is pinned on its own.** `aTimedOutOpenIsRetried` covers a `SocketTimeout` that recovers on the second attempt. `persistentTimeoutsStopAfterThreeRetries` covers a persistent `SocketTimeout` and a persistent `ConnectionTimeout`: each stops after four attempts (three retries, `ClientConfiguration.DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES`) and surfaces as `ToolPublicationStorageException` with the original cause.
- **Both null-code guards are reached.** `permanentOrUnclassifiedErrorsAreNotRetried` gains `new ClientException()` and `new OSSException("fixture")`, the only constructors that leave the error code null. Without the guards, `Set.of(...).contains(null)` throws `NullPointerException` instead of the neutral `ToolPublicationStorageException` that callers classify. The one-argument `ClientException("unknown")` already in that test sets the code to the literal `Unknown`; it delegates to the `(String, Throwable)` constructor in `aliyun-sdk-oss` 3.18.4, so it covers the "not in the set" case, not the null one.
- **A lost retry bound fails instead of hanging.** The two persistent-failure cases carry `@Timeout(10)`.

The `ClientException` fixtures use the three-argument constructor, so the error code is the one under test. The helper that builds them is `clientError(code)`.

The PR also applies the other review suggestion on #15980, which arrived after that PR merged. The `automation.scanner-threads` description no longer restates that a lease counts from its row's claim, which `automation.lease` already says. It keeps only the consequence for a long tick and points at the lease row, so the start point has one owner. The reference pages are regenerated.

## Why it's needed

#15980 updates the configuration reference's `artifacts.read-timeout` row to say that a request to open the object that times out is first retried up to three times. A review on that PR pointed out that nothing pinned the retry. It exists only because `TRANSIENT_CLIENT_ERRORS` contains the timeout codes, and the tests on `main` reach only `InternalError` and an unclassified `ClientException`. Review rounds here then found one more unpinned operand of the same method each time: first the `ClientException` null-code guard, then the `OSSException` one. So this PR now covers the whole classification at once rather than one operand per round.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

```bash
mvn -f packages/sdk-java/qwencode/pom.xml -DskipTests -Dgpg.skip=true install
mvn -f packages/managed-agent-server/pom.xml -pl verification -am -Dtest=AliyunToolPublicationObjectStoreTest -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false test
```

To see that the cases bite, apply any change from the table below to `AliyunToolPublicationObjectStore.read()` and rerun.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Twelve single-point changes to `read()`. Each was run separately against the test class on `main` (8 tests) and on this PR (11 tests), with the source restored and its mtime refreshed between runs. On `main`, surefire got a 60 s fork timeout so that a hang would end:

| Change to `read()` | `main` | This PR: failing tests |
| --- | --- | --- |
| drop `InternalError` | red (4 existing tests) | `everyTransientCodeIsRetried` and the same 4 |
| drop `ServiceUnavailable` | **passes** | `everyTransientCodeIsRetried` |
| drop `ConnectionTimeout` | **passes** | `everyTransientCodeIsRetried`, `persistentTimeoutsStopAfterThreeRetries` |
| drop `SocketTimeout` | **passes** | those two and `aTimedOutOpenIsRetried` |
| drop `ConnectionRefused` | **passes** | `everyTransientCodeIsRetried` |
| drop `UnknownHost` | **passes** | `everyTransientCodeIsRetried` |
| drop `SocketException` | **passes** | `everyTransientCodeIsRetried` |
| drop `SslException` | **passes** | `everyTransientCodeIsRetried` |
| `OSSException` arm without the null-code guard | **passes** | `permanentOrUnclassifiedErrorsAreNotRetried` (NPE) |
| `ClientException` arm without the null-code guard | **passes** | `permanentOrUnclassifiedErrorsAreNotRetried` (NPE) |
| `OSSException` arm without the retry bound | **hangs** until the fork timeout | `persistentTransientFailureStopsAfterThreeRetries` (`@Timeout`) |
| `ClientException` arm without the retry bound | **passes** | `persistentTimeoutsStopAfterThreeRetries` (`@Timeout`) |

So on `main`, 10 of the 12 changes pass and one hangs; on this PR all 12 fail within the class's own run. With the source restored, the class passes 11/11 after a clean rebuild, and `checkstyle:check` on the verification module is clean. For the scanner-threads wording, the generator check and its tests pass (38/38).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Maven with the Java SDK installed from this tree, JDK 25 (the module targets Java 21).

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff:** the class runs about 2 s longer; locally it now takes about 4 s. The persistent cases sleep through the store's backoff (100, 200 and 400 ms), and each transient code sleeps once for 100 ms. `@Timeout(10)` leaves a wide margin over the roughly 0.7 s a persistent case takes.
- **Not validated / out of scope:** the `TransientReadException` path (5xx responses classified by the client's retry strategy) is covered by the existing `AliyunToolPublicationReadRetryTest` and is unchanged. A code added to either transient set later is not detected; the test lists today's members. No production code changes.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes:** none.

## Linked Issues

Review follow-up to #15980 (thread on its `read-timeout` row); part of the deployment usability plan (#12380), item 12.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在 `AliyunToolPublicationObjectStoreTest` 中钉住 `AliyunToolPublicationObjectStore.read()` 的重试分类逻辑。每次打开 OSS 工具发布对象都经过这个方法：

- **每个瞬时错误码都会重试。** `everyTransientCodeIsRetried` 让第一次 `getObject` 依次以 `TRANSIENT_SERVICE_ERRORS`（`InternalError`、`ServiceUnavailable`）和 `TRANSIENT_CLIENT_ERRORS`（`ConnectionTimeout`、`SocketTimeout`、`ConnectionRefused`、`UnknownHost`、`SocketException`、`SslException`）中的每个成员失败一次，然后返回对象，并断言读取在恰好两次调用后成功。
- **配置参考中提到的超时单独钉住。** `aTimedOutOpenIsRetried` 覆盖第二次尝试即恢复的 `SocketTimeout`。`persistentTimeoutsStopAfterThreeRetries` 覆盖持续的 `SocketTimeout` 和持续的 `ConnectionTimeout`：两者都在 4 次尝试后停止（即重试 3 次，对应 `ClientConfiguration.DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES`），并以带原始 cause 的 `ToolPublicationStorageException` 抛出。
- **两个 null 错误码判断都被覆盖到。** `permanentOrUnclassifiedErrorsAreNotRetried` 新增 `new ClientException()` 和 `new OSSException("fixture")`，只有这两个构造函数会让错误码为 null。没有这两处判断时，`Set.of(...).contains(null)` 会抛出 `NullPointerException`，而不是调用方据以分类的中性 `ToolPublicationStorageException`。该测试中原有的单参数 `ClientException("unknown")` 会把错误码设为字面量 `Unknown`（在 `aliyun-sdk-oss` 3.18.4 中它委托给 `(String, Throwable)` 构造函数），因此它覆盖的是"不在集合中"的情形，而不是 null 的情形。
- **丢失重试上限时会失败而不是挂住。** 两个持续失败的用例加了 `@Timeout(10)`。

`ClientException` 夹具使用三参数构造函数，因此错误码就是要测试的那个。构造它们的辅助方法是 `clientError(code)`。

本 PR 还落实了 #15980 上的另一条评审建议，那条建议是在该 PR 合入后才到的。`automation.scanner-threads` 的描述不再重复"租约从该行的认领时刻起算"，因为 `automation.lease` 已经写明了这一点。现在只保留对长扫描轮次的影响，并指向 lease 那一行，让租约起算点只在一处说明。配置参考页面已重新生成。

## 为什么需要

#15980 修改了配置参考中的 `artifacts.read-timeout` 一行，写明打开对象的请求超时时会先最多重试三次。该 PR 的评审指出没有任何测试钉住这个重试：它之所以存在，只是因为 `TRANSIENT_CLIENT_ERRORS` 包含这些超时码，而 `main` 上的测试只覆盖了 `InternalError` 和一个未分类的 `ClientException`。之后这里的每一轮评审都会再找到同一方法中一个没有被钉住的判断：先是 `ClientException` 的 null 错误码判断，再是 `OSSException` 的。因此本 PR 现在一次覆盖整个分类逻辑，而不是每轮补一个。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

```bash
mvn -f packages/sdk-java/qwencode/pom.xml -DskipTests -Dgpg.skip=true install
mvn -f packages/managed-agent-server/pom.xml -pl verification -am -Dtest=AliyunToolPublicationObjectStoreTest -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false test
```

要确认这些用例确实有效，可以对 `AliyunToolPublicationObjectStore.read()` 做下表中的任意一处修改后重跑。

### 证据（修改前后）

对 `read()` 做 12 处单点修改，每处分别针对 `main` 上的测试类（8 个测试）和本 PR 的测试类（11 个测试）运行；两次运行之间恢复源码并刷新其 mtime。在 `main` 上给 surefire 设置了 60 秒的 fork 超时，使挂住的运行能够结束：

| 对 `read()` 的修改 | `main` | 本 PR：失败的测试 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 删除 `InternalError` | 失败（4 个既有测试） | `everyTransientCodeIsRetried` 加上同样的 4 个 |
| 删除 `ServiceUnavailable` | **通过** | `everyTransientCodeIsRetried` |
| 删除 `ConnectionTimeout` | **通过** | `everyTransientCodeIsRetried`、`persistentTimeoutsStopAfterThreeRetries` |
| 删除 `SocketTimeout` | **通过** | 上述两个加上 `aTimedOutOpenIsRetried` |
| 删除 `ConnectionRefused` | **通过** | `everyTransientCodeIsRetried` |
| 删除 `UnknownHost` | **通过** | `everyTransientCodeIsRetried` |
| 删除 `SocketException` | **通过** | `everyTransientCodeIsRetried` |
| 删除 `SslException` | **通过** | `everyTransientCodeIsRetried` |
| `OSSException` 分支去掉 null 错误码判断 | **通过** | `permanentOrUnclassifiedErrorsAreNotRetried`（NPE） |
| `ClientException` 分支去掉 null 错误码判断 | **通过** | `permanentOrUnclassifiedErrorsAreNotRetried`（NPE） |
| `OSSException` 分支去掉重试上限 | **挂住**，直到 fork 超时 | `persistentTransientFailureStopsAfterThreeRetries`（`@Timeout`） |
| `ClientException` 分支去掉重试上限 | **通过** | `persistentTimeoutsStopAfterThreeRetries`（`@Timeout`） |

| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |

prs.title: test(managed-agent): gate the B3 round-and-cost-budget crash window
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Packages matrix row B3 ("after earlier tools") of the hosted recovery acceptance as a fourteenth fault arm in the existing failover CI job. A multi-round fixture runs two earlier tool rounds, each with its own approval, execution and physical file effect, and the replacement Harness is crashed while a later post-tool model request is held open on the fake-model side (no new serve hook is needed). After scrashing the crashed generation's disk, the next generation must recover from MySQL alone: resume the saved logical round, restore the turn cost snapshot and the per-model token ledger, reissue the saved request deep-equal, retract the published prefix, and project exactly one terminal with the recovered answer. Both earlier Actions must end decided under their original IDs, and each earlier execution must occur exactly once under its original Runtime identity. The arm is fully gated on the new fault name, so every single-round arm is unchanged; there is no production behavior change.

## Why it's needed

B3 had focused/integration evidence only. The existing result-commit arm crashes after a single tool round; nothing crashed a replacement after several tool rounds and proved the numeric round counter and the turn cost ledger survive it. A recovery that restarts the round at 0 (letting a Turn run past its configured round limit) or zeroes the token ledger would pass CI today. "Cost budget" here is verified to mean the TurnBudget snapshot (parsed from the user's +Nk directive) plus the per-model session token ledger — there is no free-standing cumulative spend gate in the main model loop — so the arm asserts restoration fidelity of exactly that state. The ledger assertion compares per-model output-token totals with non-vacuity guards because an unrestored ledger is an empty-but-truthy object, which a null check alone would let pass; the fixture charges non-zero usage (300/300/100) so a zeroed restore totals less than the crash-boundary ledger instead of re-counting the same sum.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the new arm (it needs the bundled CLI, the server jar and a runner-private mysqld, exactly like its sibling arms): `npm run test:e2e:managed-harness-restart-approval-after-earlier-tools`. Expect a green run whose evidence shows: crash-boundary round 2 with a 500000-token snapshot and a 600-token ledger; recovered round 2 with a deep-equal snapshot and a 700-token ledger (the restored 600 plus the final round's 100 — proof the ledger was restored, not re-counted); a deep-equal reissue of the held request; both earlier executions SETTLED once each under the original Runtime identity with both file effects; both earlier Actions decided under their original IDs; the published prefix reconciled away; one terminal; the next Turn completes; close admitted 202. The contract suites pin the fixture, the choreography, the readers and every assertion; the round/budget reader also has a behavioural test on injected journal rows (including the escaped-quote JSON shape that mysql batch mode corrupts). The failover job ceiling rises from 26 to 27 arms (285 minutes).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only change. Real-stack evidence is posted as a separate comment: head green twice on the .75 Linux rig (including a post-restore re-run), three named mutation kills (round reset → round-continuity red; ledger wipe → ledger red; snapshot restore dropped → re-baselining red), and three survived mutation cells documenting that the execution-count assertion is defense-in-depth in this window (exactly-once rides three independent guards: the saved-request replay routing, the continuation route's settled-batch adoption, and the Runtime's runtimeCallId idempotency on the Java side).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS: contract suites, workflow meta-tests, full build, typecheck, ESLint, Prettier. Linux: .75 real-stack rig (Ubuntu 24.04 container, Node 22.23.3, JDK 21.0.9, MySQL 8.0.46), three-generation crash/recovery choreography with the crashed generation's disk scrashed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the fixture and several assertions are shared with the single-round approval arms; everything new is gated on the fault name, and the shared gates (hold arming AND release, prefix capture, retraction proof) enumerate both fault names — a release gated to the older arm alone was caught and fixed during real-stack verification. The contract suites and the single-round pins stay green.
- Not validated / out of scope: reddening the execution-count assertion requires a cross-language compound mutation (Java Runtime idempotency plus recovery routing), recorded as a follow-up; the skill-only / manual-continue round-reset paths' reachability in a packaged arm remains a deferred question; real-provider acceptance and full-owner restart stay separate.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Design documents (both languages, synchronized): [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/14481-b3-round-cost-budget/docs/design/2026-10-31-hosted-b3-round-cost-budget.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/14481-b3-round-cost-budget/docs/design/2026-10-31-hosted-b3-round-cost-budget.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Part of #14481 (G3 Step 3 recovery-matrix acceptance, tracks #12380).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做什么

把 hosted 恢复验收矩阵的 B3 行（「after earlier tools」）打包为现有 failover CI job 的第十四条故障支路。多轮夹具跑两个先前工具轮，每轮各有自己的审批、执行与物理文件效果；替换 Harness 在较后的 post-tool 模型请求被扣住时崩溃（hold 在 fake 模型侧，无需新 serve 钩子）。scrash 崩溃代磁盘后，下一代必须仅凭 MySQL 恢复：续跑已保存的逻辑轮次、恢复回合成本快照与每模型 token 账本、deep-equal 重发已保存请求、撤回已发布前缀、恰好投影一个带恢复答案的终态。两个先前 Action 必须在原 ID 下以 decided 结束，每个先前执行必须以原 Runtime 身份恰好发生一次。支路完全 gated 在新故障名上，单轮支路全部不变；无生产行为改动。

## 为什么需要

B3 此前仅有 focused/integration 证据。现有 result-commit 支路在单个工具轮之后崩溃；没有任何支路在若干工具轮之后崩溃并证明数值轮次计数器与回合成本账本跨替换存活。一个把轮次重启为 0（让 Turn 跑过配置轮次上限）或把 token 账本归零的恢复，今天都能通过 CI。此处「成本预算」经实证指 TurnBudget 快照（从用户 +Nk 指令解析）加每模型会话 token 账本——主模型循环没有独立的累计花费闸门——因此支路断言的正是该状态的恢复保真。账本断言比较逐模型输出 token 总量并带非空守卫，因为未恢复的账本是空但 truthy 的对象，仅查 null 会空过；夹具计入非零 usage（300/300/100），使归零恢复的总量低于崩溃边界账本，而非把同一总和重算一遍。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

运行新支路（与兄弟支路一样需要 bundled CLI、server jar 与 runner 私有 mysqld）：`npm run test:e2e:managed-harness-restart-approval-after-earlier-tools`。预期绿跑，证据显示：崩溃边界 round 2、500000 token 快照、600 token 账本；恢复后 round 2、快照 deep-equal、700 token 账本（恢复的 600 加最终轮 100——证明账本被恢复而非重算）；被扣住请求 deep-equal 重发；两个先前执行各以原 Runtime 身份 SETTLED 一次且两个文件效果都在；两个先前 Action 在原 ID 下 decided；已发布前缀被撤回；一个终态；下一 Turn 完成；close 准入 202。契约套件钉住夹具、编排、读法与每条断言；轮次/budget 读法另有注入日志行的行为化测试（含 mysql batch 模式会损坏的转义引号 JSON 形状）。failover job 上限从 26 抬到 27 臂（285 分钟）。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A——纯测试改动。真机证据以独立评论发布：.75 Linux rig 上 head 绿两次（含还原后重跑）、三条命名变异击杀（轮次重置→轮次连续红；账本归零→账本红；丢弃快照恢复→重新起算红），以及三个存活变异格，证明执行计数断言在此窗口是纵深防御（恰好一次依赖三道独立守卫：saved-request replay 路由、continuation 路由的 settled-batch 采纳、Java 侧 Runtime 的 runtimeCallId 幂等）。

### 测试平台

macOS ✅（契约套件、workflow 元测试、全量 build、typecheck、ESLint、Prettier）；Linux ✅（.75 真机 rig，Ubuntu 24.04 容器、Node 22.23.3、JDK 21.0.9、MySQL 8.0.46，三代崩溃/恢复编排并 scrash 崩溃代磁盘）；Windows N/A。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：夹具与若干断言与单轮审批支路共享；所有新增内容 gated 在故障名上，共享 gate（hold 的 arm 与释放、前缀采集、撤回证明）枚举两个故障名——只 gate 旧支路的释放已在真机验证中抓住并修复。契约套件与单轮钉保持绿。
- 未验证/范围外：使执行计数断言变红需要跨语言复合变异（Java Runtime 幂等加恢复路由），已记录为后续；skill-only/手动 continue 轮次重置路径在打包臂中的可达性仍是延后问题；真实 provider 验收与两侧 owner 重启仍独立。
- 破坏性改动/迁移说明：无。

设计文档（双语同步）：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/14481-b3-round-cost-budget/docs/design/2026-10-31-hosted-b3-round-cost-budget.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/14481-b3-round-cost-budget/docs/design/2026-10-31-hosted-b3-round-cost-budget.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

属于 #14481（G3 Step 3 恢复矩阵验收，跟踪 #12380）。

</details>
